npc.hjaern.greet_msg_1: Be greeted, |PLAYERNAME|. The {spiritual} world looks upon you and your deeds.
npc.hjaern.multi_1: Thank you my friend. The local representative of the explorers society has asked for our help ...
npc.hjaern.multi_10: These are alarming news and we have to act immediately. Take this spirit charm of cold. Travel to the mines and find four special obelisks to mark them with the charm ...
npc.hjaern.multi_11: I can feel their resonance in the spirits world but we cant reach them with our magic yet. They have to get into contact with us in a spiritual way first ...
npc.hjaern.multi_12: This will help us to concentrate all our frost magic on this place. I am sure this will prevent to melt any significant number of demons from the ice ...
npc.hjaern.multi_13: Report about your mission when you are done. Then we can begin with the great ritual of summoning the children of Chyll ...
npc.hjaern.multi_14: I will also inform Lurik about the events. Now go, fast!
npc.hjaern.multi_15: There is no need to report about your mission. To be honest, Ive sent a divination spirit with you as well as a couple of destruction spirits that were unleashed when you approached the altar ...
npc.hjaern.multi_16: Forgive me my secrecy but you are not familiar with the spirits and you might have get frightened. The spirits are at work now, destroying the magic with that those evil creatures have polluted Helheim ...
npc.hjaern.multi_17: I cant thank you enough for what you have done for the spirits of my people. Still I have to ask: Would you do us another favour?
npc.hjaern.multi_18: There is indeed an important mission. For a long time, the spirits have been worried and have called us for help. It seems that some of our dead have not reached the happy hunting grounds of after life ...
npc.hjaern.multi_19: Everything we were able to find out leads to a place where none of our people is allowed to go. Just like we would never allow a stranger to go to that place ...
npc.hjaern.multi_2: You know their ways better than my people do and are probably best suited to represent us in this matter.
npc.hjaern.multi_20: But you, you are different. You are not one of our people, yet you have proven worthy to be one us. You are special, the child of two worlds ...
npc.hjaern.multi_21: We will grant you permission to travel to that isle of Helheim. Our legends say that this is the entrance to the dark world. The dark world is the place where the evil and lost souls roam in eternal torment ...
npc.hjaern.multi_22: There you find for sure the cause for the unrest of the spirits. Find someone in Svargrond who can give you a passage to Helheim and seek for the cause. Are you willing to do that?
npc.hjaern.multi_23: We could indeed need some help. These are very cold times. The ice is growing and becoming thicker everywhere ...
npc.hjaern.multi_24: The problem is that the chakoyas may use the ice for a passage to the west and attack Svargrond ...
npc.hjaern.multi_25: We need you to get a pick and to destroy the ice at certain places to the east. You will quickly recognise those spots by their unstable look ...
npc.hjaern.multi_26: Use the pickaxe on at least three of these places and the chakoyas probably won't be able to pass the ice. Once you are done, return here and report about your mission.
npc.hjaern.multi_3: Search for Lurik and talk to him about aprobable mission he might have for you.
npc.hjaern.multi_4: You encountered the restless ghost of my apprentice Tylaf in the old mines? We must find out what has happened to him. I enable you to talk to his spirit ...
npc.hjaern.multi_5: Talk to him and then report to me about your mission.
npc.hjaern.multi_6: Yes, I can feel it! The spirits are in touch with the obelisks. We will begin to channel a spell of ice on the caves. That will prevent the melting of the ice there ...
npc.hjaern.multi_7: If you would like to help us, you can turn in frostheart shards from now on. We use them to fuel our spell with the power of ice. ...
npc.hjaern.multi_8: Oh, and before I forget it - since you have done a lot to help us and spent such a long time in this everlasting winter, I have a special present for you. ...
npc.hjaern.multi_9: Take this outfit to keep your warm during your travels in this frozen realm!
npc.hjaern.say_1: [EN] Here your are. {} gold coins for {} shards.
npc.hjaern.say_10: [EN] Excellent, you collected 5 of them. If you have collected 5 or more, talk to me about your {reward}.
npc.hjaern.say_11: [EN] Excellent, you collected 10 of them. If you have collected 15 or more, talk to me about your {reward}.
npc.hjaern.say_13: You have no cookie that I'd like.
npc.hjaern.say_14: In the name of the spirits I accept this offer ... UHNGH ... The spirits are not amused!
npc.hjaern.say_16: Here your are. {} gold coins for {} shards.
npc.hjaern.say_2: I have now no mission for you.
npc.hjaern.say_3: Do you bring frostheart shards for our spell?
npc.hjaern.say_4: [EN] Do you bring frostheart shards for our spell?
npc.hjaern.say_5: [EN] Do you want to sell all your shards for 2000 gold coins per each?
npc.hjaern.say_6: [EN] Take this. It might suit your Nordic outfit fine.
npc.hjaern.say_7: [EN] Take this. It might suit your Nordic outfit fine. From now on we only can give you 2000 gold pieces for each shard.
npc.hjaern.say_8: You want to sacrifice a cookie to the spirits?
npc.hjaern.say_9: [EN] This is good news. As I explained, travel to Helheim, seek the reason for the unrest there and then report to me about your mission.
npc.hugo.bat_deliver: Did you get me the 10 bat wings?
npc.hugo.bat_done: Well, what do you expect? Bat wings come from bats, of course.
npc.hugo.bat_not_enough: No, no. I need more bat wings! I said, 10!
npc.hugo.bat_success: Hooray! These bat wings are ugly enough. Now the last thing: Please bring me 30 heaven blossoms to neutralise the ghoulish stench.
npc.hugo.blossom_deliver: Is this the lovely smell of 30 heaven blossoms?
npc.hugo.blossom_done: A flower favoured by almost all elves.
npc.hugo.blossom_not_enough: These few flowers are not enough to neutralise the ghoulish stench.
npc.hugo.blossom_success: This is it! I will immediately start to work on this outfit. Come back in a day or something... then my new creation will be born!
npc.hugo.cloth_deliver: Ah! Have you brought 20 pieces of brown cloth?
npc.hugo.cloth_done: Ghouls sometimes carry it with them. My assistant Irmana can also fabricate cloth from secondhand clothing.
npc.hugo.cloth_not_enough: Uh, that is not even enough cloth for a poor dwarf's look.
npc.hugo.cloth_success: Yes, yes, that's it! Very well, now I need 50 pieces of minotaur leather to continue.
npc.hugo.leather_deliver: Were you able to obtain 50 pieces of minotaur leather?
npc.hugo.leather_done: If you don't know how to obtain minotaur leather, ask my apprentice Kalvin. I'm far too busy for these trivial matters.
npc.hugo.leather_not_enough: Uh, that is not even enough leather for a poor dwarf's look.
npc.hugo.leather_success: Great! This leather will suffice. Now, please, the 10 bat wings.
npc.hugo.multi_1: Good! Listen, I need the following material - first, 20 pieces of brown cloth, like the worn and ragged ghoul clothing. ...
npc.hugo.multi_2: Secondly, 50 pieces of minotaur leather. Third, I need bat wings, maybe 10. And 30 heaven blossoms, the flowers elves cultivate. ...
npc.hugo.multi_3: Have you noted down everything and will help me gather the material?
npc.hugo.multi_4: I think I'm having an innovative vision! I feel that people are getting tired of attempting to look wealthy and of displaying their treasures. ...
npc.hugo.multi_5: A really new and innovative look would be - the 'poor man's look'! I can already see it in front of me... yes... a little ragged... but not too shabby! ...
npc.hugo.multi_6: I need material right now! Argh - the vision starts to fade... please hurry, can you bring me some stuff?
npc.hugo.say_1: A new uniform for the post officers? I am sorry but my dog ate the last dress pattern we used. You need to supply us with a new dress pattern.
npc.hugo.say_10: Here you go. Maybe you enjoy if after all.
npc.hugo.say_11: Argh! I guess this awesome idea has to remain unimplemented. What a pity.
npc.hugo.say_12: Do you want me to repeat the task requirements?
npc.hugo.say_13: Hurry! I am at my creative peak right now!
npc.hugo.say_14: Well, if you should change your mind, just ask me for the beggar outfit.
npc.hugo.say_2: It was ... wonderous beyond wildest imaginations! I have no clue where Kevin Postner got it from. Better ask him.
npc.hugo.say_3: By the gods of fashion! Didn't it do that I fed the last dress pattern to my poor dog? Will this mocking of all which is taste and fashion never stop?? Ok, ok, you will get those ugly, stinking uniforms and now get lost, fashion terrorist.
npc.hugo.say_4: Sorry, but my time is currently reserved for premium matters.
npc.hugo.say_5: I am so excited! This poor man's look will be an outfit like the world has never seen before.
npc.hugo.say_6: Sorry, but I am not done with the outfit yet. Venore wasn't built in a day.
npc.hugo.say_7: Eureka! Alas, the poor man's outfit is finished, but... to be honest... it turned out much less appealing than I expected. However, you can have it if you want, okay?
npc.hugo.say_8: I guess my vision wasn't that grand after all. I hope there are still people who enjoy it.
npc.hugo.say_9: Terrific! What are you waiting for?! Start right away gathering 20 pieces of brown cloth and come back once you have them!
npc.humgolf.say_1: Bah, Farmine here, Farmine there. Is there nothing else than Farmine to talk about these days? Hrmpf, whatever. So what do you want?
npc.humgolf.say_2: You are here to apologise? Have you got anything that would make me reconsider my decision never to talk to you again about this subject?
npc.humgolf.say_3: Yeah, of course they can't do without my worms. Mining and worms go hand in hand. Well, in the case of the worms it is only an imaginary hand of course. I'll send them some of my finest worms.
npc.humgolf.say_4: Hah! Now you talk like a dwarf! That's the spirit! Of course you can have some of my worms. I'll send a bunch to Farmine as soon as possible.
npc.humgolf.say_5: Uh, how cute! Look how he's snapping for my fingers! You really know how to make an old dwarf happy! Well, so let's try again. Why do you think I should send my precious worms to Farmine?
npc.humphrey.keyword_1: So receive the embrace of Tibia, pilgrim.
npc.humphrey.stdmod_1: Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |BLESSCOST| gold, child?
npc.humphrey.stdmod_10: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.humphrey.stdmod_11: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.humphrey.stdmod_12: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.humphrey.stdmod_13: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.humphrey.stdmod_14: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.humphrey.stdmod_2: So receive the embrace of Tibia, pilgrim.
npc.humphrey.stdmod_3: Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.humphrey.stdmod_4: You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.humphrey.stdmod_5: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.humphrey.stdmod_6: Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.humphrey.stdmod_7: There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.humphrey.stdmod_8: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.humphrey.stdmod_9: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.huntsman.multi_1: [EN] As a matter of fact though, if too many animals are killed, things might rapidly change for the worse. ...
npc.huntsman.multi_2: [EN] So it's only practical thinking to keep the balance in mind as long as I can afford it.
npc.huntsman.multi_3: So it's only practical thinking to keep the balance in mind as long as I can afford it.
npc.huntsman.say_1: I hunt game of all sorts to earn a living. I respect the {balance} of nature though and take only as much as I need.
npc.huntsman.say_2: She is a bit overly concerned about that nature and balance stuff but she has a good heart. She is living in the woods between Carlin and Ab'Dendriel. I'll mark her hut on your map.
npc.huntsman.say_3: The white deer are somewhat sacred to the elves. Though their fur and antlers are rumoured to earn a decent amount of {gold} on the market, it's probably not worth the trouble.
npc.huntsman.say_4: Just between you and me, I heard a guy named {Cruleo} is offering some handsome cash for the trophies of a white deer.
npc.huntsman.say_5: He has a house in the wilderness. Just between Ab'Dendriel and the orcland. I'll mark his hut on your map.
npc.huntsman.stdmod_2: Sorry, I don't think telling a stranger your name is a smart thing to do.
npc.hyacinth.greet_msg_1: Greetings, traveller |PLAYERNAME|. You must be the one sent by Lily. Do you have a sack of {herbs} for me?
npc.hyacinth.greet_msg_2: Greetings, traveller |PLAYERNAME|. I still have a present for you! Would you like to have it now?
npc.hyacinth.greet_msg_3: Greetings, traveller |PLAYERNAME|. As you have found the way to my hut, how can I {help} you?
npc.hyacinth.sendtrade_msg_1: Here. Don't forget, if you buy potions, there's a {deposit} of 5 gold on the empty flask.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_1: Thank you so much! I'm just too old to walk into the village each day, and the herbs must be fresh. Say, would you like to have a sample of my potions as reward?
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_10: May Crunor bless you and protect you on your journeys!
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_11: There are only two other druids on Rookgaard, {Lily} and {Cipfried}.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_13: Who knows what it will be? Only time will show.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_15: What help do you seek? I sell health potions, ask me for a {trade} if you need one.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_16: I can't teach you magic. On the {mainland} you will learn spells early enough.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_17: I'm one of the few magic users on this isle. I can sense a follower of the dark path of magic hiding somewhere in the depths of the dungeons.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_18: It is shaped by the will of the gods, so we don't have to question it.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_19: I used to be there with my old friend Cipfried to heal adventurers. After all these years, I prefer solitude now.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_2: Well, then I must have mistaken you with someone else. Or did you lose it on the way?
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_20: Teaching you about the gods would require too much time. But you can always read the books in the {library}.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_21: The library is in the {academy}, north of the {temple}.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_23: Are you hungry? I'm sorry, I have no food here.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_24: Yes, I sell small health potions. Ask me for a trade if you need one.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_25: I don't care about kings, queens, and the like.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_26: I rarely visit the town. It's much better here.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_27: There's a huge world waiting for you.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_28: Most of the so-called monsters of this isle are only creatures of the gods. There are some beasts that are truly monstrous on the {mainland}.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_29: Are you hungry? I'm sorry, I have no food here.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_3: That's too bad... but I'm sure Lily could give you another one. Just walk back and talk to her again.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_30: The dungeons are dangerous for inexperienced adventurers.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_31: Just ask me for a {trade} to check out my offers. I have only small health potions for sale, though.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_32: You'll have to buy that from the merchants in town. I'm just a simple druid and healer.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_33: I'll pay you 5 gold for every empty vial and potion flask. Just ask me for a {trade}.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_34: A greedy and annoying person just like most people are.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_35: Now she has completely gotten out of her mind.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_36: He was a promising young druid when something happened to his mind. It's a sad story.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_37: He does a good job out there.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_38: I know her since she was little.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_4: Alright then. Good luck on your travels.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_40: I saw her stranding with her raft.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_41: He's a farmer and behaves a little better than his cousin.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_44: I think she's under bad influence.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_5: Oh, but I insist! After all you made the long way. Please, take my reward!
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_53:
Here you go - two small health potions. If you use them on yourself, they will recover some of your hitpoints. ... \z
	I recommend setting them on a hotkey so you don't have to search for them in a case of emergency. ... \z
	Once you are a bit more experienced and have chosen a vocation, you'll have access to many different potions and also spells to restore your health. ... \z
	Oh, and I also have another present for you! Do you still have some space in your inventory?
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_54:
Take this star ring. When you wear it in your ring slot, it will improve the effect of food that you have eaten for a limited time. So as long as you're not hungry, you will have increased hitpoint regeneration. ... \z
	It makes sense to undress it when you have full hitpoints, so that the effect of the ring won't be wasted. ... \z
	There are a lot of different rings in Tibia, but this one only works as long as you haven't learnt a vocation, so don't be afraid to use it. ... \z
	Anyway, thanks so much for your help. I can brew a lot of potions from these herbs. If you're in the area and find yourself in need of potions, don't hesitate to drop by and ask me for a {trade}. ... \z
	Anyway, this old man has taken enough of your time. Why don't you go back to the village and talk to Vascalir? If you stay on the path, you should be safe. Don't forget your potions!
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_6: Well, make some space and then talk to me again. I give you something really useful.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_9: I'm a {druid} and healer, a follower of {Crunor}.
npc.ikassis.multi_1: Nature's blessings! You may find the desperate wolf mother in the south of Cormaya. You will know the place because there is a big stone that looks like a grumpy face. ...
npc.ikassis.multi_2: At night it will weep bloody tears and only at night you will meet the ghost there. Take this talisman so you may be able to talk with animals and even plants and stones. Just don't expect that all of them will answer you.
npc.ikassis.multi_3: One of my sisters, in the disguise of a nightingale, told me that Alkestios would send you. There is a problem which is not concerning me but a wolf mother on the small island Cormaya. ...
npc.ikassis.multi_4: As we, the fae, consider ourselves guardians and protectors of plants and animals, it is important for me to help this wolf. Unfortunately, I can't do it myself because at the moment I'm bound to this vessel, this snake. ...
npc.ikassis.multi_5: Thus I can't cross the ocean to reach Cormaya. Will you help me?
npc.ikassis.say_1: The wolf's ghost has found peace. Thank you, human being. However, there is someone else who needs help: A sister of mine who's bereft of something very precious. You'll find her in the guise of a swan at a small river south-east of here.
npc.ikassis.say_2: You are not on that mission.
npc.imalas.greet_msg_1: Hello |PLAYERNAME|! What do you need? If it's {food}, you've come to the right place.
npc.imalas.stdmod_1: I offer quite a lot of food. Ask me for a {trade} if you're hungry
npc.imbuement_assistant.farewell_msg_1: See you later |PLAYERNAME| come back soon.
npc.imbuement_assistant.greet_msg_1: Hello |PLAYERNAME|, say {imbuement packages} or {trade} for buy imbuement items.
npc.imbuement_assistant.packages_list: These are the available imbuement packages, Skill increase: {bash}, {blockade}, {chop}, {epiphany}, {precision}, {slash}. Additional attributes: {featherweight}, {strike}, {swiftness}, {vampirism}, {vibrancy}, {void}. Elemental damage: {electrify}, {frost}, {reap}, {scorch}, {venom}. Elemental protection: {cloud fabric}, {demon presence}, {dragon hide}, {lich shroud}, {quara scale}, {snake skin}.
npc.imbuement_assistant.say_1: Sorry, you don't have enough money
npc.imbuement_assistant.say_2: You have successfully completed your purchase of the items.
npc.imbuement_assistant.say_3: The selected package costs {} gold. Do you want to buy it?
npc.imbuement_assistant.say_4: Sorry, you don't have enough money
npc.imbuement_assistant.say_5: Do you want to buy items for {} imbuement for {} gold?
npc.imbuement_assistant.say_6: You have successfully completed your purchase of the items.
npc.imbuement_assistant.voice_1: Hello adventurer, looking for Imbuement items? Just ask me!
npc.imbuement_assistant.walkaway_msg_1: See you later |PLAYERNAME| come back soon.
npc.imbul.stdmod_1: Do you seek a passage to the {0} for {1}?
npc.imbul.stdmod_3: I can bring you either to the {east} end of Port Hope or to the {centre} of the town, where would you like to go?
npc.inigo.greet_msg_1: You came through the {portal}! \z Though it must be different from where you came from, I'm sure you can help us. But first, I can {help} YOU.
npc.inigo.hint_1: If you don't know the meaning of an icon on the minimap, move the mouse cursor on it and wait a moment.
npc.inigo.hint_10: Be careful when you approach three or more {monsters} because you only can block the attacks of two! In such a situation, even a few salamanders can do severe damage or even kill you.
npc.inigo.hint_11: There are many ways to gather {food}. Many creatures drop food but you can also pick blueberries or bake your own bread. If you have a {fishing rod} and worms in your inventory, you can also try to catch a fish.
npc.inigo.hint_12: Baking bread is rather complex. First of all you need a scythe to harvest wheat. Then you use the wheat with a millstone to get flour. This can be be used on water to get dough, which can be used on an oven to bake bread. Use milk instead of water to get cake dough.
npc.inigo.hint_13: {Dying} hurts! Better run away than risk your life. You are going to lose experience and skill points when you die. And anyone can loot your corpse if you are not blessed.
npc.inigo.hint_14: When you switch to '{Offensive} {Fighting}', you deal out more damage but you also get hurt more easily.
npc.inigo.hint_15: When you are on low health and need to run away from a monster, switch to '{Defensive} {Fighting}' and the monster will hit you less severely.
npc.inigo.hint_16: Many creatures try to run away from you. Select 'Chase Opponent' to follow them.
npc.inigo.hint_17: The deeper you enter a dungeon, the more dangerous it will be. Approach every dungeon with utmost care or an unexpected creature might kill you. This will result in losing experience and skill points.
npc.inigo.hint_18: Due to the perspective, some objects in {Tibia} are not located at the spot they seem to appear (ladders, windows, lamps). Try clicking on the floor tile the object would lie on.
npc.inigo.hint_19: Almost as important as a {rope} is a {shovel}. Many things can be dug out of the sand, and a pile of loose stones might hide a secret entrance. But if you go down an unknown hole, make sure you have a rope with you to get you out quickly if necessary!
npc.inigo.hint_2: If you seek more information, look at or click on objects near you, like wall signs, blackboards or books in book cases - many of them have useful information on {Tibia} or maybe even a quest you are doing. By the way, to receive more of my hints, just say {hints} again.
npc.inigo.hint_20: Stairs, ladders and dungeon entrances are marked as yellow dots on the automap.
npc.inigo.hint_21: You can get {food} by killing animals or {monsters}. You can also pick blueberries or bake your own bread. If you are too lazy or own too much money, you can also buy food.
npc.inigo.hint_22: Quest containers can be recognised easily. They don't open up regularly but display a message 'You have found ....'. They can only be opened once.
npc.inigo.hint_23: Better run away than risk to die. You'll lose experience and skill points each time you die.
npc.inigo.hint_24: You can form a party by right-clicking on a player and selecting 'Invite to Party'. The party leader can also enable 'Shared Experience' by right-clicking on him- or herself.
npc.inigo.hint_25: You can assign {spells}, the use of items, or random text to 'hotkeys'. You find them under 'Options'.
npc.inigo.hint_26: You can also follow other {players}. Just right-click on the player and select 'Follow'.
npc.inigo.hint_27: You can found a party with your friends by right-clicking on a player and selecting 'Invite to Party'. If you are invited to a party, right-click on yourself and select 'Join Party'.
npc.inigo.hint_28: Only found parties with people you trust! You can attack people in your party without getting a {skull}. This is helpful for training your {skills}, but can be abused to kill people without having to fear negative consequences.
npc.inigo.hint_29: The leader of a party has the option to distribute gathered experience among all {players} in the party. If you are the leader, right-click on yourself and select 'Enable Shared Experience'.
npc.inigo.hint_3: If you want to attack a monster, simply click on it in your battle list. A red frame around a monster shows you are attacking it.
npc.inigo.hint_30: If you see someone with a {skull} symbol next to their name, it means he or she has attacked or even killed another player. Be careful around such people, as their next target might be you.
npc.inigo.hint_31: A brown frame around a player means he or she is in a {PvP} situation.
npc.inigo.hint_32: To open or close {skills}, battle or VIP list, click on the corresponding button. The buttons are displayed to the left or right of your game window.
npc.inigo.hint_33: If you want to trade an item with another player, right-click on the item and select 'Trade with ...', then click on the player with whom you want to trade.
npc.inigo.hint_34: Send private messages to other {players} by right-clicking on the player or the player's name and select 'Message to ....'. You can also open a 'private message channel' and type in the name of the player.
npc.inigo.hint_35: There is nothing more I can tell you. If you are still in need of some {hints}, I can repeat them for you.
npc.inigo.hint_4: If you already know where you want to go, click on the automap and your character will walk there automatically if the location is reachable and not too far away.
npc.inigo.hint_5: Always have a {rope} with you! If you fall into a hole and are surrounded by {monsters}, quickly use the rope with the ropespot to get back up and out.
npc.inigo.hint_6: 'Capacity' restricts the amount of things you can carry with you. It raises with each level.
npc.inigo.hint_7: Always have a look on your health bar. If you see that you do not regenerate health points anymore, eat something.
npc.inigo.hint_8: Always eat as much {food} as possible. This way, you'll regenerate health points for a longer period of time.
npc.inigo.hint_9: After you have killed a monster, you have 10 seconds in which the corpse is not movable and no one else but you can loot it.
npc.inigo.say_1: It seems to emanate a magical call or pulse that draws all sorts of creatures to it - no offense meant. When we first found it, we were flabbergasted - we thought maybe a mad sorcerer had built it, or a cult, to summon something evil. ...
npc.inigo.say_10: Fighting is essential in Tibia, and though Dawnport is quite safe in comparison to the mainland, be careful not to die, as {dying} HURTS. ...
npc.inigo.say_11: If you have any other questions, tell me.
npc.inigo.say_12: There are many dangers in {Tibia}. You may have to defend yourself not only against {monsters}, but if {PvP} is allowed, against other {players}, too. ...
npc.inigo.say_13: To attack, click on your chosen target in the battle list. A red frame will show you which target you are currently attacking. ...
npc.inigo.say_14: To automatically follow your target, click on 'Chase Opponent' in your combat controls - the top left button. ...
npc.inigo.say_15: You can also define your attack and defense mode, by selecting {offensive}, {balanced} or {defensive} fighting.
npc.inigo.say_16: Depending on the world you chose in {Tibia}, {players} may attack you at all times or only if you consent. ...
npc.inigo.say_17: On an Optional PvP world, PvP is only possible if both players consent to it; but on Open PvP or Hardcore PvP worlds, any player may always attack you, so be watchful. ...
npc.inigo.say_18: A brown frame around a player indicates he or she is in a PvP situation. A {skull} next to a player name means he or she attacked or killed another player. ...
npc.inigo.say_19: Here on {Dawnport}, PvP is not allowed inside the outpost, and not possible until you have reached level 8 at least. If you have any other questions, tell me.
npc.inigo.say_2: But we didn't find any conclusive hints. {Menesto} and a few others volunteered to guard the portal from the {monsters} of this isle. You say you came through it from your world! Astounding. ...
npc.inigo.say_20: To chat with other players, you can click on one of the chat channels and see who is posting in there. ...
npc.inigo.say_21: If you want to message a specific player, right-click on his or her name and select 'Message to <player name>'. This will open up a chat channel where you can type in your message to him or her.
npc.inigo.say_22: NPC means someone like me or {Hamish} or {Coltrayne}, for example. You can easily discern us from {players} like you, because there is a speech bubble next to our {name}. ...
npc.inigo.say_23: We all have our different ways, but normally, addressing an NPC with 'hi' or 'hello' will open a conversation. ...
npc.inigo.say_24: Some NPCs will have secret words that they react to that are not highlighted in their conversation. In that case, you need to type in your question. ...
npc.inigo.say_25: To do so, open the NPC Chat Channel and click on the empty space below the NPCs dialogue, and start typing. ...
npc.inigo.say_26: You can try this out by asking an NPC about their {job}, as this is a keyword most will react to. If you have any other questions, tell me.
npc.inigo.say_27: Every vocation has specific spells that can only be used if you have that vocation. Sorcerers and druids of course rely heavily on spells, while knights only have a few at their disposal. ...
npc.inigo.say_28: As an adventurer in training, you have a few spells at your disposal at the beginning, but more will become available as you progress. ...
npc.inigo.say_29: Once you're level 8, new spells become available upstairs at the spell trainers {Garamond} and {Tybald}. They can tell you more.
npc.inigo.say_3: You couldn't have chosen a better time. We really need help against the monsters that swarm this island, and the whole world of {Tibia}. If you're unsure on how to {help} exactly, I can give you directions.
npc.inigo.say_30: Second best thing to a rope - a shovel will reveal secret entrances buried under loose stone piles, or under sand, or earth... you will see! ...
npc.inigo.say_31: Shovels can be bought at {Richard}'s, like the other equipment, or food. If you don't have the money yet, go out and kill some {monsters} outside - and maybe you'll even find a shovel, who knows!
npc.inigo.say_32: We found the island following a strange glow we saw at night, close before dawn. We were looking for a source of unknown, powerful magic, and it seemed that this island was its source. ...
npc.inigo.say_33: When we arrived, we found goblins, minotaurs, trolls and undead warring on this island. We wondered why. Then they seemed to reach an agreement, and settled down in the caves. We decided to investigate. ...
npc.inigo.say_34: That is when we found the strange crystal {portal}, through which you came. Perhaps this is why the {monsters} battle, but won't leave. ...
npc.inigo.say_35: It certainly is a place of power, so {Menesto}'s group was sent down to guard it. However, we are but few, so we need every help we can get to defend and maintain the outpost on this isle. ...
npc.inigo.say_36: That is why we need your help - choose the vocation that suits you, take up its arms and help us defend this place against the evil that wants to claim it! If you need any help in how to do these things, ask me.
npc.inigo.say_37: The mainland harbours the most ancient cities of {Tibia}, and many dangers and adventures as well. When you have helped us defend {Dawnport}, and learned enough of the ways of Tibia to reach level 8 at least, you should leave for the mainland. ...
npc.inigo.say_38: There you can continue to battle evil - and believe me, there is much of that in our world, alas. <sigh> ...
npc.inigo.say_39: Premium adventurers can also sail to the many islands that surround the mainland, which offer many more dangers and mysteries to be explored; and you can do quests to ride mounts, and dress in a variety of new outfits.
npc.inigo.say_4: Hasn't been with us for very long. Very interested in all things mystical, so Menesto was sent down to guard the strange crystal {portal} we found here. ...
npc.inigo.say_40: Go through one of the open gates on this floor and you will be equipped with training weapons and {spells} of a specific vocation. ...
npc.inigo.say_41: There are four vocations in Tibia: {knight}, {druid}, {paladin} and {sorcerer}. Each one has its unique abilities, strengths and weaknesses. Just try them out to see which one suits you best. ...
npc.inigo.say_42: We need your help in our battle. Fight {monsters} to gain experience and better {skills}, until you reach level 8 at least. Make sure you always have not only a weapon, but a {rope} with you, as well! ...
npc.inigo.say_43: Once you reached level 8 or more, you have to choose one vocation as your definite vocation before you can leave for the Tibian {mainland}, where more dangers await you. ...
npc.inigo.say_44: To choose your definite vocation, talk to {Oressa} downstairs in the {temple}. She can also heal you if you are severely wounded or poisoned - just say 'heal' or 'help' to her. ...
npc.inigo.say_45: If you have any other questions, tell me.
npc.inigo.say_46: A vocation is your profession and chosen destiny, rolled into one. There are four vocations in {Tibia}: {knight}, {sorcerer}, {paladin} or {druid}. Each vocation has its unique special abilities with which to fight evil. ...
npc.inigo.say_47: You need to choose your vocation before you can leave {Dawnport} to go to the {Mainland}. But first, you have to gain enough experience to reach level 8 in order to do so. ...
npc.inigo.say_48: Once you've reached level 8 and want to choose your definite vocation, talk to {Oressa} downstairs in the temple. She can also heal you if you are hurt or poisoned. ...
npc.inigo.say_49: If you have any other questions, tell me.
npc.inigo.say_5: ... But of course, you met him. ... So it really is a portal, and you came through it from another plane of existence! I never quite believed the tales of old, not really. But now... it's wonderful, truly wonderful. ...
npc.inigo.say_50: I can give you directions how to {play}, some basic survival and {combat} tips, or explain {PvP}, ...
npc.inigo.say_51: I can also tell you how to talk with other {players} or {NPC}s, or can inform you about {questing} or {spells}. ...
npc.inigo.say_52: I also have a list of small {hints} if you prefer that, and can tell you something of the {people} here. Just tell me what you want to know. ...
npc.inigo.say_53: Oh, but first that help I mentioned - you should get yourself a {shovel}, friend. It will come in handy when you set about finding secret entrances to dungeons or hidden treasures - many useful things lie hidden beneath earth, sand or stones!
npc.inigo.say_54: Offensive {fighting} means you deal harder attacks, but have a weaker defense. Magical damage you deal is not affected by this. ...
npc.inigo.say_55: You should switch to offensive only if you want to finish off a monster quickly and are sure you can survive its harder attacks. I can also tell you something about {balanced} and {defensive} fighting.
npc.inigo.say_56: Balanced {fighting} balances out your attack strength as well as your defense strength. Magical damage you deal is not affected by this. ...
npc.inigo.say_57: I can also tell you something about {offensive} and {defensive} fighting.
npc.inigo.say_58: Defensive {fighting} increases your defense but reduces your attack strength. The magical damage you deal is not affected by this. ...
npc.inigo.say_59: I can also tell you something about {offensive} and {balanced} fighting.
npc.inigo.say_6: Well, if you have any questions as to THIS plane of existence, which we call {Tibia}, just ask me. I can give directions, {hints}, you name it. <winks at you>
npc.inigo.say_60: A white skull means that this player attacked and maybe killed another player without justification. ...
npc.inigo.say_61: A red skull means someone has killed many other {players}, while a black skull depicts someone on a serious killing spree - so watch out!
npc.inigo.say_62: Some sort of misguided genius, I think. Brilliant with potions and runes, but couldn't get on with his master or with the other students. Ran away and set up his own little lab, selling to travellers along the road. ...
npc.inigo.say_63: Was robbed and left for dead by some plunderers, when Morris found him. {Morris} patched him up and said he could use him, so Hamish came here. If you need a wand, rune or potion, Hamish's your man.
npc.inigo.say_64: Coltrayne doesn't say much about himself. What I gathered from the 15 years I've known him is that he was raised by a blacksmith as a foundling. ...
npc.inigo.say_65: When a fire destroyed his foster family's home, he took up an unsteady life, always wandering around. Then he met {Morris} and decided to go adventuring with him.
npc.inigo.say_66: Ah, there are lots of stories about Morris. Likes to insist on the 'Mr'. Nobody knows his first name, and the telling goes that he has gambled with a demon and lost his first name to him. ...
npc.inigo.say_67: The demon is said to have set Morris free so he can reclaim him at the end of his life, meanwhile having fun watching Morris struggle through hardship and adventures. ...
npc.inigo.say_68: Anyway. One way or another, Morris picked us all up and gathered us here. Not sure that sending others on missions is really all it's about for him, but if you're looking for a quest, go ask Morris for one.
npc.inigo.say_69: Not your level, but your skill with your weapon determines how much damage you make. With a distance weapon like a bow, you {train} your distance {fighting} skill, with a sword your sword fighting, etc. ...
npc.inigo.say_7: Our world {Tibia} is swarmed by many dangerous {monsters}, so {fighting} is something you will have to learn and master quickly. You can fight as a {sorcerer}, druid, {paladin} or {knight}. ...
npc.inigo.say_70: Druids and sorcerers train their magic level by using their mana through {spells} and runes. Their wand or rod damage is not affected by their magic level. If you have any other questions, tell me.
npc.inigo.say_71: You should never leave without a rope. NEVER. A rope can save your life. I once fell down into a poison spider lair - without a rope, I wouldn't be standing here today! ...
npc.inigo.say_72: You can buy a rope over at {Richard}'s shop. If you don't have the money, kill and loot a few {monsters} - maybe one of them even has a rope with it, that sort of thing happens.
npc.inigo.say_73: Our local healer. Don't know why that druid girl decided she wanted the unsteady life of an adventurer, but she's quite hardy, to tell the truth. I once saw her confront a polar bear.... but I'm getting carried away. ...
npc.inigo.say_74: If you need healing, go see her. Oressa can also help you decide if you want to choose your vocation to leave for the {Mainland}.
npc.inigo.say_75: When you die, you will be resurrected in the temple of the city you chose as your home. Temple {NPC}s, like {Oressa} here on {Dawnport}, can heal you if you're wounded or poisoned. Some special temple NPCs can also {bless} you. ...
npc.inigo.say_76: To be fully blessed, you should start the Pilgrimage of Ashes at a local guide in the harbour once you have reached the {mainland}.
npc.inigo.say_77: Don't be deceived by its sweet looks - {Tibia} is a rough world. If you die, you will lose skill and experience and perhaps even some items, and other {players} can rob your corpse. ...
npc.inigo.say_78: On the {Mainland}, you can buy blessings from {temple} {NPC}s to prevent item loss, but you will always lose some {skills} and experience, so be careful. ...
npc.inigo.say_79: Always have a {rope} with you, for a start. A rope is essential.
npc.inigo.say_8: We need your help in keeping the monsters at bay - walk out of one of the four gates here, and you will receive one of the four {vocations} and its gear to try out and fight monsters. ...
npc.inigo.say_80: Every vocation has specific {spells} that can only be used if you have that vocation. Sorcerers and druids of course rely heavily on spells, while knights only have a few at their disposal. ...
npc.inigo.say_81: As an adventurer in training, you have a few spells at your disposal at the beginning, but more will become available as you progress. ...
npc.inigo.say_82: Once you're level 8, new spells become available upstairs at the spell trainers {Garamond} and {Tybald}. They can tell you more.
npc.inigo.say_83: Go through one of the open gates on this floor and you will be equipped with training weapons and {spells} of a specific vocation. ...
npc.inigo.say_84: There are four {vocations} in Tibia: {knight}, {sorcerer}, {paladin} or {druid}. Each one has its unique abilities, strengths and weaknesses. Just try them out to see which one suits you best. ...
npc.inigo.say_85: We need your help in our battle. Fight {monsters} to gain experience and better {skills}, until you reach level 8 at least. Make sure you always have not only a weapon, but a {rope} with you, as well! ...
npc.inigo.say_86: Once you reached level 8 or more, you have to choose one vocation as your definite vocation before you can leave for the Tibian {mainland}, where more dangers await you. ...
npc.inigo.say_87: To choose your definite vocation, talk to {Oressa} downstairs in the {temple}. She can also heal you if you are severely wounded or poisoned - just say 'heal' or 'help' to her. ...
npc.inigo.say_88: If you have any other questions, tell me.
npc.inigo.say_89: The blessings of the gods will protect you from item loss and alleviate the skill and experience loss when you die. But you will have to undertake the Pilgrimage of Ashes on the {mainland} to get the blessings. ...
npc.inigo.say_9: {Dawnport} is just a small, but dangerous island. You will have to reach level 8 at least and choose your definite vocation before you can leave for the {mainland}. To reach level 8, you will have to fight some monsters in order to progress. ...
npc.inigo.say_90: If you die in a fight from a monster's attack, your blessings will be lost, and you will have to get them again. ...
npc.inigo.say_91: There is also a blessing that will protect you specifically from losses in a {PvP} fight. This blessing you will need to get again when you have been killed in a PvP fight. ...
npc.inigo.say_92: Here on {Dawnport}, you are protected from losses in a PvP fight by the Adventurer's Blessing - unless you attack another player. If you attack another player or reach level 20, you will lose this blessing.
npc.inigo.say_93: Careful, careful, it's a one-way ticket only! You can never come back here if you leave now, and you will loso all your Dawnport equipment and products! ...
npc.inigo.say_94: Are you {SURE} you want to {LEAVE} Dawnport for ROOKGAARD?
npc.inigo.say_95: Hmmm. Long time I visited that isle. Not very exciting place. Why do you ask? Do you wish to go there?
npc.inigo.say_96: Then so be it. I'm sorry to see you go, but if this is what you want, step this way... right. Now, cover your eyes... GO!
npc.inigo.say_97: I'm sorry, but I cannot let you go there, you'll get much better training here than on that ancient isle.
npc.inigo.stdmod_1: I know the ways and lays of Dawnport. Talk to me if you want to know more!
npc.inigo.stdmod_10:
I used to be a hunter and trapper, but these bones have grown weary. \z
		I now tan furs and hides and {trade} in creature products. And I can help you find your way if you need directions.
npc.inigo.stdmod_11:
That's where we are - the world of Tibia. \z
		We're on a small island called {Dawnport}, not far from the coast of the Tibian {Mainland}, to be precise.
npc.inigo.stdmod_12:
Oh, I can handle my tasks myself, thank you. \z
		If you are looking for something to do, you should go to Morris and ask him for quests. \z
		You can also help us fight {monsters}.
npc.inigo.stdmod_13:
Well, the other fellows you see here, selling stuff and so forth. \z
		Say a name and I'll tell you what I know of him or her.
npc.inigo.stdmod_14:
Marvellous specimen we have here on {Dawnport}! \z
		Just be careful when you go hunting them, {dying} hurts in {Tibia}! \z
		I will happily buy any creature products you may find.
npc.inigo.stdmod_15:
Used to be a professor at the magic academy in Edron, I believe. \z
		Likes to see different places, so he joined our illustrous little group. \z
		Sells {sorcerer} and {druid} {spells} to our trainees.
npc.inigo.stdmod_16:
I'm not sure that's his actual name, but I guess he has good reasons to stay incognito here. \z
		In any case, he's a formidable fighter and knows usefull {spells} for knights and paladins.
npc.inigo.stdmod_2: Troll hair, wolf fur, lumps of dirt - bring them to me!
npc.inigo.stdmod_3: Come to me if you need help!
npc.inigo.stdmod_4: Hey there, young adventurer! Need a hint?
npc.inigo.stdmod_5: You came through the portal? Talk to me!
npc.inigo.stdmod_6: You're going out? Make sure you have a rope with you!
npc.inigo.stdmod_7: Buying all sorts of creature products!
npc.inigo.stdmod_8: You're looking thoughtful. Maybe I can help you?
npc.inigo.stdmod_9:
Ah, back in the old days, I was called Inigo Verasquiriz, but I doubt my family would acknowledge me. \z
		Those that are still alive, that is.
npc.inigo.voice_1: I know the ways and lays of Dawnport. Talk to me if you want to know more!
npc.inigo.voice_2: Troll hair, wolf fur, lumps of dirt - bring them to me!
npc.inigo.voice_3: Come to me if you need help!
npc.inigo.voice_4: Hey there, young adventurer! Need a hint?
npc.inigo.voice_5: You came through the portal? Talk to me!
npc.inigo.voice_6: You're going out? Make sure you have a rope with you!
npc.inigo.voice_7: Buying all sorts of creature products!
npc.inigo.voice_8: You're looking thoughtful. Maybe I can help you?
npc.inkaef.say_1: So you ask me for a {{}} to begin your adventure?
npc.inkaef.say_2: What? I have already gave you one {{}}!
npc.inkaef.say_4: Sorry, you aren't a druid either a sorcerer.
npc.inkaef.say_5: Here you are young adept, take care yourself.
npc.iptar-sin.stdmod_1:
A blessed stake to defeat evil spirits? I do know an old prayer which is said to grant sacred power and to be able to bind this power to someone, or something. ... \z
	However, this prayer needs the combined energy of ten priests. Each of them has to say one line of the prayer. ... \z
	I could start with the prayer, but since the next priest has to be in a different location, you probably will have to travel a lot. ... \z
	Is this stake really important enough to you so that you are willing to take this burden?
npc.iptar-sin.stdmod_2:
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
npc.iptar_sin.greet_msg_1: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free or you want the {adventurer stone}?
npc.iptar_sin.keyword_1: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_1: Alright, I guess you need a stake first. Maybe Gamon can help you, the leg of a chair or something could just do. Try asking him for a stake, and if you have one, bring it back to me.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_11: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_14: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_16: Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_18: You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_19: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_2: I guess you couldn't convince Gamon to give you a stake, eh?
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_20: Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_21: There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_22: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_23: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_24: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_25: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_26: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_27: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_28: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_29: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_3: Yes, I was informed what to do. Are you prepared to receive my line of the prayer?
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_30: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_4: So receive my prayer: 'Light shall be near - and darkness afar'. Now, bring your stake to Tibra in the Carlin church for the next line of the prayer. I will inform her what to do.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_6: You should visit Tibra in the Carlin church now.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_7: You already received my line of the prayer.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_8: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_9: Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.iptar_sin.walkaway_msg_1: Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
npc.irmana.greet_msg_1: Welcome to the house of fashion, |PLAYERNAME|!
npc.irmana.multi_1: A wolf whelp fur? Well, some months ago a hunter came here - a rather scruffy, smelly guy. I would have thrown him out instantly, but he had to offer some fine pelts. One of them was the fur of a very young wolf. ...
npc.irmana.multi_10: This accessory requires a small fee of 150000 gold pieces. Of course, we do not want to put you at any risk to be attacked while carrying this huge amount of money. ...
npc.irmana.multi_11: This is why we have established our brand-new instalment sale. You can choose to either pay the price at once, or if you want to be safe, by instalments of 10000 gold pieces. ...
npc.irmana.multi_12: I also have to inform you that once you started paying for one of the accessories, you have to finish the payment first before you can start paying for the other one, of course. Are you interested in purchasing this accessory?

npc.irmana.multi_3: You can have it if this is important for you. I would sell it for 1000 gold. Are you interested?

npc.irmana.say_1: Currently we are offering accessories for the nobleman - and, of course, noblewoman - outfit. Would you like to hear more about our offer?

npc.isimov.stdmod_11: I think you have forgotten to bring your stake, kid.
npc.isimov.stdmod_12: Yes, I was informed what to do. Are you prepared to receive my line of the prayer?
npc.isimov.stdmod_13: So receive my prayer: 'Unclean spirits shall be repelled'. Now, bring your stake to Amanda in Edron for the next line of the prayer. I will inform her what to do.
npc.isimov.stdmod_15: You should visit Amanda in Edron now, kid.
npc.isimov.stdmod_16: You already received my line of the prayer.
npc.isimov.stdmod_17: A blessed stake? That's a strange request. Maybe Quentin knows more, he is one of the oldest monks after all.
npc.isimov.stdmod_18: You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.isimov.stdmod_19: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.

npc.isimov.stdmod_20: Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.isimov.stdmod_21: There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.isimov.stdmod_22: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.isimov.stdmod_23: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.isimov.stdmod_24: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.isimov.stdmod_25: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.isimov.stdmod_26: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.isimov.stdmod_27: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.isimov.stdmod_28: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.isimov.stdmod_29: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.isimov.stdmod_30: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.isimov.stdmod_32:
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?

npc.isimov.stdmod_7: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.isimov.stdmod_9: Sorry, you don't have enough money.

npc.iskan.greet_msg_1: You are not one of us. I don't want to talk to you.
npc.iskan.greet_msg_2: I was told you have been killing huskies here in Svargrond! Never do that again, okay? They are precious animals for us. Give me 500 gold and I will forget that incident without telling it to Jarl Sven. Okay?
npc.iskan.greet_msg_3: HAIL to the Warlord of the arena! |PLAYERNAME|, Hero of Svargrond! What can I {do for you}?
npc.iskan.greet_msg_4: Greetings. What can I {do for you}?
npc.iskan.multi_1: That's surprising. Take a piece of meat. If you find the boy, feed it to him. That will give him enough strength and incentive to return to his pack ...
npc.iskan.multi_2: Talk to him by calling his name 'Sniffler' and tell him you got meat for him. After he has eaten the meat, return here to talk to me about your mission.
npc.iskan.multi_3: Well, one of the boys has run away. I think he got the scent of some beast. He's young and inexperienced so I can't blame the cub ...
npc.iskan.multi_4: I would like you to see after him. He should be somewhere north west of the town. He is probably marking his territory so you should be able to find his trace. Are you willing to do that?
npc.iskan.say_1: So, do you want a passage to Nibelor my friend?
npc.iskan.say_3: You are a friend of mine and the boys now. I tell you something. If you ever need to go to the isle of Nibelor, just ask me for a {passage}.
npc.iskan.say_4: I have now no mission for you.
npc.iskan.say_5: Sorry but I only give missions to those who are considered a true Barbarian.
npc.iskan.say_7: You don't have enough. Bring me the money and I will forget about it.
npc.iskan.say_8: Sorry, first time you have to do a mission for me.
npc.iskan.say_9: Mhmm, you leave me no other choice than to inform the Jarl.
npc.iskan.stdmod_1: I run the dog sled service from this city to {Nibelor}.
npc.iskan.stdmod_10: The yeti is real and dangerous.
npc.iskan.stdmod_11: I am not sure what to think about this new custom to accept foreigners as one of us after passing that test. But it's the Jarl's decision, not mine.
npc.iskan.stdmod_12: The raiders camps are far to the south. There are three of them. Small camp sites of raiding parties might be found almost anywhere though.
npc.iskan.stdmod_13: They are sometimes trying to catch me and the boys. Such fools, they will never get us. Right, boys?
npc.iskan.stdmod_14: The boys can tell who's an enemy just by the smell.
npc.iskan.stdmod_15: Me and the boys care only about our own territory.
npc.iskan.stdmod_16: I guess their healing powers are almost as useful as those of our shamans.
npc.iskan.stdmod_17: I guess there are guys like me that have a talent to talk to dogs and there are guys like the shamans that have the talent to talk to spirits.
npc.iskan.stdmod_18: We don't need any kings or queens. Am I right, boys? Yeah, I am.
npc.iskan.stdmod_19: Sven the Younger is our current Jarl. For my standards he's still a puppy, but a smart one at least.
npc.iskan.stdmod_20: Yeah, where could it be. That's the question.
npc.iskan.stdmod_21: Easy, boys! Don't mention that name again. Makes the boys nuts, ye know?
npc.iskan.stdmod_22: In my whole long life, I've not seen any sign of those gods the people of the south are constantly talking about.
npc.iskan.stdmod_23: The icy father. We know him all too well, am I right boys? He has claimed so many old friends in all those years. So many.
npc.iskan.stdmod_24:
I'll tell you something. I have seen such a creature once, far on the ice to the east. It was the coldest winter I can remember and the chakoyas were roaming the ice almost everywhere. ... \z
	To evade them, me and the boys had to walk a long way to a spot where the ice was treacherous and thin. ... \z
	And there I've seen such a creature. The boys went almost mad and I turned my sled immediately. No idea how we made it home. True story.
npc.iskan.stdmod_3: I can bring you to Nibelor with the sled if you want to. Just ask for a {passage}.
npc.iskan.stdmod_4: This city seems to be growing every day. First, there have been only a few huts and now ... look around, houses everywhere.
npc.iskan.stdmod_5: Our people are very proud and honest. I guess that's more than most people can say about themselves and their people, right boys?
npc.iskan.stdmod_6: I heard something about a ship crashing in the shelf ice between Nibelor and Grimlund. If I were you, I wouldn't go to chakoya terrain. It's pretty dangerous.
npc.iskan.stdmod_7: Nasty little beasts. Me and the boys had quite some bloody encounters with them on the ice.
npc.iskan.stdmod_8: The boys warn me in advance if a monster is around.
npc.iskan.stdmod_9: My boys did not like the guys that were travelling through our city, and I trust in their instincts. Isn't it so, boys?
npc.ivalisse.greet_msg_1: Hello, worshiper of the Astral Shapers! Welcome to the temple! While you are here to pay tribute, you can also learn something about the ancient art of imbuing.
npc.ivalisse.multi_1: Thank you! He told me the other researchers in his team discovered a bridge leading to a cave with a dragon sculpture somewhere in a muggy, grassy area. ...
npc.ivalisse.multi_10: Papa- my father has recently started an adventure on his own. His name is Silus; he is a member of the Edron academy. ...
npc.ivalisse.multi_11: Ever since he joined what he called a 'special research division', he went on and on about Zao and how venturing there would help him get ahead. ...
npc.ivalisse.multi_12: You must know he lives for science, especially concerning faraway lands and cultures. He talked about the importance of practical field studies but, frankly, he isn't particularly cut out for that. ...
npc.ivalisse.multi_13: I know he has to focus to get his research done right now, and I simply cannot leave my duties in the temple. You seem like a person who travels a lot; would you be willing to help me?
npc.ivalisse.multi_14: The astral Shapers had many ways to shape and refine weapons and equipment. They built shrines dedicated to this world's energies, focussing it and utilising it like a tool to enhance objects. ...
npc.ivalisse.multi_15: They called this process imbuing and perfected it throughout time. Remains of these shrines are scattered all over Tibia. ...
npc.ivalisse.multi_16: If you truly want to master this art, you will need to visit the various ancient sites related to the original Shaper imbuements. There is one for each element and we know of at least one other besides these. ...
npc.ivalisse.multi_17: The discovery of the foundations of this very temple we are standing in, was the key to access their legacy. It is now the center of all our efforts in getting closer to the astral predecessors. ...
npc.ivalisse.multi_18: They found ways to connect various sites with a system of gates, all concentrating energy to allow travel to far away places. The more we learn, the more we can restore of these ancient gateways. ...
npc.ivalisse.multi_19: We see the gates as an invitation, use them to your advantage and follow the ways of the Shapers. Access to one of these ancient shrines is the only way to learn additional imbuements. ...
npc.ivalisse.multi_2: The cave is said to lead to a temple complex underground which is ued as a gathering place for a race called 'draken'. He left right away and tried to enter Zao on his own. ...
npc.ivalisse.multi_20: But beware, as far as we know, some of them have been claimed by other ancient beings and there is now way for us to prepare you what lies beyond any of those gates.
npc.ivalisse.multi_3: I was even more worried when he explained the route he chose. he wanted to head straight through a giant steppe and through a massive mountainous ridge to reach the grassy plains of lower Zao. ...
npc.ivalisse.multi_4: If you're interested: I know that the Shapers where active in all corners of Tibia. If you happen to find Shaper ruins there, you may even be able to gather some of their lost knowledge. ...
npc.ivalisse.multi_5: I may have been a bit stubborn and angry the day he left, I even refused to say farewell. And now I worry if he is safe. ...
npc.ivalisse.multi_6: I can not do much to help you but I can open a portal to get you quite close to his last known location in Zao. What do you say, will you help me find my father?
npc.ivalisse.multi_7: What? You're telling me you found father? How is he? What did papa say? A chalice? As a disguise? The whole time? ...
npc.ivalisse.multi_8: Well, I am not as much surprised as I am happy to hear that he's alright. You know, after the incident with the duck and the umbrella—it doesn't get to me that easily anymore. ...
npc.ivalisse.multi_9: Thank you very much for doing all this for me; I will be forever grateful. I have nothing to repay you with, but you are already blessed to have been able to lay eyes on the sacred Shaper ruins.
npc.ivalisse.say_1: Well, I hope you like it here. We tried to rebuild in the {Shaper}'s will. I am a bit preoccupied at the moment because of the absence of my {father}. I may not be the best of help currently, sorry.
npc.ivalisse.say_2: Besides my various {duties} in the temple, I also take care of visitors. Well, I would but right now I can't get my mind of how my {father}'s doing. I am sorry.
npc.ivalisse.say_3: Well, I hope you like it here. We tried to rebuild in the Shaper's will. I am a bit preoccupied at the moment because of the absence of my father. I may not be the best of help currently, sorry.
npc.ivalisse.say_4: You would? That's great! Thank you! If you can find my father, tell him I understand and that I really miss him!
npc.ivalisse.say_5: Oh nevermind, I am sorry I asked you for this.
npc.ivalisse.stdmod_1: My {father}, can you tell me if he's alright?
npc.ivalisse.stdmod_2: Alright then, you are very welcome to explore the temple!
npc.ivalisse.stdmod_4: There is always time to make a change.
npc.ivalisse.stdmod_5: Besides my various {duties} in the temple, I also take care of visitors. Well, I would but right now I can't get my mind of how my {father}'s doing. I am sorry.

npc.izsh.multi_1: Fine, zo let'z prozeed. You uzed forged documentz to enter our zity, killed zeveral guardz who enjoyed a quite excluzive and expenzive training, deztroyed rare magical devizez in ze pozzezzion of ze emperor. ...
npc.izsh.multi_10: Ze rednezz of your faze and ze zound you make wiz your teez iz obviouzly a zign of gratitude of your zpeziez! I am flattered, but pleaze leave now az I have to attend to zome important buzinezz.

npc.jack.greet_msg_1: You!! What have you told my family? They are mad at me and I don't even know why! They think I lied to them about working in Edron in secrecy! Why should I even do that!
npc.jack.greet_msg_2: So, you've returned to Spectulus? What did he say, is anything wrong? You have this strange expression on your face - is there anything wrong? You DID tell me the truth here, didn't you?
npc.jack.greet_msg_3: Yes? What can I do for you? I hope this won't take long, though.
npc.jack.greet_msg_4: What did you do to my SCULPTURE? You simply DESTROYED it? Why? You... you ruined everything... my house, my hobby, my life. My family even refuses to talk to me anymore. ...
npc.jack.greet_msg_5: Alright, alright you win. I am done for. You... you must be right, yes. Yes, I was working as an intern... in the academy in Edron... yes... Just... tell this Spectulus guy I want to see him. I have nothing left. I am ready.
npc.jack.multi_1: Ah, also a keen lover of arts I assume? You might have already caught a glimpse of that humble masterpiece over there in the corner - I sculpt sulky sculptures! ...
npc.jack.multi_2: Sculpting sculptures was my passion since childhood... ...and it was there at my first sandcastle when... ...and it formed... ...and it developed into... ...years of enduring sculpting... ...carved of something like... ...sulky... ...
npc.jack.multi_3: And that's what I like to do to this very day - hey, hey will you wake up? Were you even listening to me?
npc.jack.multi_4: I see. Well for starters, I think you're crazy. If I would have 'travelled' in some kind of - device? - that thing should be around here somewhere, or not? ...

npc.jack_fate_goroma.multi_1: Thank you. Luckily the damage my ship has taken looks more severe than it is, so I will only need a few wooden boards. ...
npc.jack_fate_goroma.multi_2: I saw some lousy trolls running away with some parts of the ship. It might be a good idea to follow them and check if they have some more wood. ...
npc.jack_fate_goroma.multi_3: We will need 30 pieces of wood, no more, no less. Did you understand everything?
npc.jack_fate_goroma.say_1: I'd love to bring you back to Liberty Bay, but as you can see, my ship is ruined. I also hurt my leg and can barely move. Can you help me?
npc.jack_fate_goroma.say_2: Have you brought 30 pieces of wood so that I can repair the ship?
npc.jack_fate_goroma.say_3: Do you want to travel back to Liberty Bay?

npc.jack_fate_goroma.say_5: Excellent! Now we can leave this godforsaken place. Thank you for your help. Should you ever want to return to this island, ask me for a passage to Goroma.
npc.jack_fate_goroma.stdmod_1: My name is Jack Fate from the Royal Tibia Line.
npc.jack_fate_goroma.stdmod_2: I'm the captain of this - well, wreck. Argh.
