npc.maris_fenrock.stdmod_3: I can take you to {Yalahar} or {Mistrock}!
npc.maris_fenrock.stdmod_4: I can take you to {Yalahar} or {Mistrock}!
npc.maris_fenrock.stdmod_5: I am Maris, Captain of this ship.
npc.maris_fenrock.stdmod_6: I am Maris, Captain of this ship.

npc.maris_mistrock.stdmod_4: I can take you to {Yalahar} or {Fenrock}!
npc.maris_mistrock.stdmod_5: I am Maris, Captain of this ship.

npc.maris_mistrock.stdmod_7:
Do you smell this? It's the smell of fire... the fire of a forge. Many people searched this rock here for a hidden path, but they haven't found anything. ... \z
	I'd search on Fenrock if I were you. Even though there's snow on the surface, it's still warm underground. There are often caves under fresh lava streams.
npc.maritima.multi_1: The quara in this area are a strange race that seeks for inner perfection rather than physical one. ...
npc.maritima.multi_2: Considering that they are quara, they are rather peaceful as long no one enters their territory. ...
npc.maritima.multi_3: However, recently the quara got mad because their area is flooded with toxic sewage from the city. If you could inform someone about it, they might stop the sewage and the quara could return to their own business.
npc.markwin.greet_msg_2: Well ... you defeated my guards! Now everything is over! I guess I will have to answer your questions now.
npc.markwin.say_1: No! The hornless have reached my city! BODYGUARDS TO ME!
npc.markwin.say_2: A letter from my Moohmy?? Do you have a letter from my Moohmy to me?
npc.markwin.say_4: Uhm, well thank you, hornless being.
npc.markwin.say_5: You have no cookie that I'd like.
npc.markwin.say_6: I understand this as a peace-offering, human ... UNGH ... THIS IS AN OUTRAGE! THIS MEANS WAR!!!
npc.marlene.farewell_msg_1: Good bye and come again for another small talk! *waves*
npc.marlene.greet_msg_1: Ahhh, welcome |PLAYERNAME|! Say, have you already heard the latest news about the {seamonster}, {Aneus}, or the {rumours} in this area?
npc.marlene.multi_1: Well, I heard about evil beings living in a dungeon below us. So once I tried to find them and went down the hole far to the southwest. ...
npc.marlene.multi_10: He must have collected so much wisdom. *sigh* I wish I could also travel around the world. ...
npc.marlene.multi_11: I would try to visit as many cities and meet as many beings as possible. Who knows what strange races I will meet? ...
npc.marlene.multi_12: Maybe I can also find a lovely new dress for me. I have been looking for one for months now but never found a good one. Maybe... *keeps on babbling*
npc.marlene.multi_13: Only some days ago I was at the docks late in the night and was looking for my husband's ship when suddenly a known noise appeared near the docks. ...
npc.marlene.multi_14: I know this noise very well because it is the noise of a ship sailing very fast. I searched the horizon in hope to see my husbands ship. ...
npc.marlene.multi_15: But instead of a ship I saw a huge shape far away. It was like a big snake swimming in the sea. ...
npc.marlene.multi_16: I couldn't see it clearly because of the fog but I think I saw two lava-red eyes glowing in the nightly fog. ...
npc.marlene.multi_17: I ran into the house and hoped that my husband would arrive safely from fishing. And after one hour he finally arrived. ...
npc.marlene.multi_18: I told him about what I saw but he didn't believe me because he never saw anything like that in all the years before. But you believe me right? Go and convince yourself. ...
npc.marlene.multi_19: Just go to the docks at exactly midnight and be very quiet. Look at the horizon and maybe you will hear and see it, too!
npc.marlene.multi_2: I'm pretty curious, you know. *smiles* So I took the coat of invisibility from my husband and went down there. At first I only found some spiders, snakes, and wolves. ...
npc.marlene.multi_3: But after some time I found a ladder to a deeper level of the dungeon but I didn't dare to go down there because I heard many voices. ...
npc.marlene.multi_4: The voices were very strange and I ran back to my house because they were very loud and very angry. I hope they will never get the idea to attack the surface beings. ...
npc.marlene.multi_5: I heard they are almighty and have incredible powers! I already packed our stuff for an emergency escape. You never know. Maybe they plan to conquer the whole world. ...
npc.marlene.multi_6: I bet that they look very ugly. Most mighty monsters look very ugly. Hmm, you seem to be very strong. Maybe you can go deeper and explore the area. But be careful, please. ...
npc.marlene.multi_7: I heard that they can kill humans with only one hit! And that they have magic abilities twenty times stronger than the mightiest sorcerer in our world.
npc.marlene.multi_8: A very nice person. He has a great story to tell with big fights and much magic. Just ask him for his story. ...
npc.marlene.multi_9: I heard that he came from far, far away. He must have seen soooo many countries, cities, different races. ...
npc.marlene.stdmod_2: I'm Bruno's wife. Besides: Have you already heard the latest news about the seamonster, Aneus, or the rumours in this area?
npc.marlene.stdmod_3: Bruno is a wonderful husband. But he is seldom at home. *looks a little bit sad*
npc.marlene.stdmod_4: Ah, old Graubart. A very nice person. But he is strange. He always is busy when I want to talk to him. *lost in thoughts*
npc.marlene.stdmod_5: My pleasure, I always enjoy sharing interesting stories.
npc.marvin.greet_msg_1: Ah, you come just in time for the special voting about the most recent {funding} project. I guess you want to participate in it.
npc.marvin.multi_1: So far you earned x votes. Each single vote can be spent on a different topic or you're also able to cast all your votes on one voting. ...
npc.marvin.multi_2: Well in the topic b you have the possibility to vote for the funding of the {archives}, import of bug {milk} or street {repairs}.
npc.marvin.say_2: How many of your x votes do you want to cast?
npc.marvin.say_3: Did I get that right: You want to cast 1 of your votes on funding the {archives}?
npc.marvin.say_4: Thanks, you successfully cast your vote. Feel free to continue gathering votes by helping the city! Farewell.
npc.maryza.say_1: Welcome to the Jolly Axeman, |PLAYERNAME|. Have a good time and eat some food!
npc.maryza.say_2: The cookbook of the famous dwarven kitchen. You're lucky. I have a few copies on sale. Do you like one for 150 gold?
npc.maryza.say_3: I'm sorry but I sell only one copy to each customer. Otherwise they would have been sold out a long time ago.
npc.maryza.say_4: No gold, no sale, that's it.
npc.maryza.say_6: I have but a few copies, anyway.
npc.mazarius.greet_msg_1: Greetings, dear visitor. Please tell me what {brings} you here, to my humble adobe.
npc.mazarius.multi_1: With all their powers and vast magic knowledge they are still more pawns than anything else. Given their resources, ascension might seem within reach. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_10: Therefore he has to tap into other, probably even more sinister power sources. I can't tell what these sources are, but my scrying revealed that he has reached massive amounts of power. He has probably been infusing himself since years. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_11: By now he is apparently reaching the end circle of his ascension and could make his final move any day.
npc.mazarius.multi_12: Ascension is a fascinating topic that dates back to efforts and philosophies of some of the most ancient, and mostly extinct, races which fought in the godwars. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_13: Probably born out of desperation, they extensively researched ways to acquire godhood themselves. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_14: Some of them at least even met with moderate success. But the process is complicated at best, and may vary from race to race or even from one individual to another. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_15: The theories differ vastly and waxed and waned in popularity over the centuries if not aeons. Even today and in human society there are a number of obscure ascension cults. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_16: Some of them claim that humans are most suitable for ascension because they already own a bit of divinity through Banor's godly spark.
npc.mazarius.multi_17: It is a place, so to say, not completely of this world. It is separate of, yet strongly connected to, our own world. I would imagine it is quite limited in size and its laws of physics and magic should be roughly the same as ours. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_18: Being home to a host of demons for a while, I expect it to be a hostile and dangerous environment.
npc.mazarius.multi_19: For a long time, I thought the godbreaker to be some apocryphal myth. But apparently others had learned about the godbreaker in the aeons past and lusted for its power. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_2: The absence of any ascendant demon might prove that they are no true beings at all and literally damned to be stuck in their accursed forms.
npc.mazarius.multi_20: They had gathered hint after hint - until, ultimately, they were squashed by the Seven or their minions; which only made the leads that hinted at them all the more probable. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_21: What Zathroth hoped to accomplish with the creation of such a weapon can only be subject to speculation. Assumedly he already had slain Tibiasula, so the godbreaker might have been even more powerful, more absolute. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_22: However, it has to be assumed that in the end the sheer power of his creation scared Zathroth, who had to fear the weapon could one day be used against him. So he disassembled it. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_23: [EN] Knowing that they would never, ever allow one of their own to come in possession of all parts. Since then, the parts have been hidden in a {demi-plane} shared by the Seven.
npc.mazarius.multi_24: [EN] Well, I need 30 {demonic essences} to exchange for a passage so you can access.
npc.mazarius.multi_25: Well, I need 30 {demonic essences} to exchange for a passage so you can access.
npc.mazarius.multi_26: My studies indicate that without all doubt Ferumbras the fiendish is in the process of accumulating nearly godlike powers. We have to stop him.
npc.mazarius.multi_27: Therefore I need you to enter a hellish dimension and acquire the parts of a weapon, the {godbreaker}, powerful enough to stop him once and for all. Are you willing to help me in this dire mission?
npc.mazarius.multi_28: He obviously had taken an interest to the topic of ascension, and I came into possession of some of his early writings. ...You have to know I'm a scholar of some renown. In the course of my latest studies about ascension, I stumbled upon disturbing facts about the person of the all too well known Ferumbras, the fiendish. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_29: This, combined with investigation and divination, bit by bit led to the conclusion that all that Ferumbras has done in the past may be part of a cunning plan. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_3: The elves are like lost children. Their potential might be great, but they lack focus and dedication to truly improve. If their myths are true, some of the more early elves might have accomplished ascension. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_30: Considering his writings and the books he based them upon, it became clear that Ferumbras is planning his ascension to godlike status. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_31: All of his attacks and defeats only served one purpose: to become an integral part of the people's knowledge, fears and beliefs. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_32: He actually used this as an energy source, and combined it with some sources of power which might not all be of our own world. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_33: He uses this energy to increasingly empower himself and will eventually be prepared to take the final step to transform himself into a godlike being. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_34: With the knowledge what to look for, I acquired expensive but powerful artefacts to scry the world for the expected power signature - and indeed I made contact. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_35: To my horror I had to recognise that Ferumbras had already made significant progress, and his final bid for ascension is imminent! ...
npc.mazarius.multi_36: His power levels are already too high for there to be any hope of stopping him with conventional means. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_37: But not all is lost yet. During my studies about godhood, I learned that the dark Zathroth himself had created a weapon so powerful that it could actually slay a god. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_38: [EN] Ancient, forbidden texts hinted at a hellish place where the seven built deadly dungeons, and placed some of their most fearsome and terrible minions as guards, before they sealed the place off. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_39: [EN] I'm confident that I can prepare a matching ritual that will breach their protection and allow someone to enter their realm; but I'm in no way suited to handle the horrors to be encountered there. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_4: Yet even if hints strongly suggest those stories are true, the sheer inaction of those assumedly ascended beings is disturbing. Perhaps what those legendary elves achieved was something completely different.
npc.mazarius.multi_40: [EN] Therefore I have to ask you, if you are willing to retrieve the parts of the godbreaker, and face the threat of the ascending Ferumbras?
npc.mazarius.multi_41: Therefore I have to ask you, if you are willing to retrieve the parts of the godbreaker, and face the threat of the ascending Ferumbras?
npc.mazarius.multi_5: The dwarves are leftovers from a time long gone by. They have outlived their usefulness to the gods and seem to have come to terms with that. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_6: They are as unchanging as rock and no greatness awaits them any more. They missed their chance, if they ever had any.
npc.mazarius.multi_7: Although already powerful in his own right, it is obvious that his ultimate goal seems to be the ascension to godly powers. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_8: His whole existence seems to be centred on becoming a name that strikes fear into the heart of men and to become a persistent figure in the minds of humanity. ...
npc.mazarius.multi_9: This gives him a hold in reality and a kind of mould to fill with his power and conscience. It's also obvious that this kind of belief of the people alone won't be enough to empower him sufficiently. ...
npc.mazarius.say_1: Ah, you have heard about my search for experienced help. And indeed your reputation for solving certain {problems} has preceded you.
npc.mazarius.say_10: Thais has become a melting pot of some source. Yet whatever you melt, if the ingredients are corrupted, the outcome is always flawed.
npc.mazarius.say_11: Instead of banding together and starting to change something, they and Thais keep wasting resources in hostilities.
npc.mazarius.say_12: Edron has become as stagnant as the teachings in its academy. No new idea has been thought there for decades. The whole Edron is an example for what happens when humanity has become fat and lazy.
npc.mazarius.say_13: An almost laughable greed is persistent in that city. At least this makes knowledge and materials conveniently available to those who can match their prizes.
npc.mazarius.say_2: My problems are, so to say, dire news for the whole world. <sigh> I don't want to confuse you with overly complicated and lengthy stories, so do you want to hear the {long} version or the {short}?
npc.mazarius.say_3: Good!, but I need 30 {demonic essences} to exchange with the demonic messenger for a ticket for you to enter the Abodes of Torments.
npc.mazarius.say_4: Do you have 30 demonic essences to offer to the demonic messenger?
npc.mazarius.say_5: Excellent! This will empower possibilty to create a breach is enough to let you pass into that hellish hiding place. ...
npc.mazarius.say_6: You don't have the demonic essences, back here when you get it.
npc.mazarius.say_7: Given the internal power plays amongst the Seven, they are the ideal keepers for individual parts of an powerful artefact. Not one of them would allow his compatriots to hold such a power, and neither would trust the other.
npc.mazarius.say_8: Ah, a good man and a competent aid.
npc.mazarius.say_9: I like the quietness and the climate. And admittedly it helped my studies not to be constantly disturbed by petitioners.
npc.mehkesh.greet_msg_1: Be mourned, |PLAYERNAME|, pilgrim in flesh. If you are looking for potions, seek no further.
npc.mehkesh.voice_1: Potions brewed by the leading alchemists of the land!
npc.melchior.farewell_msg_1: Farewell, stranger. May Uman the Wise guide your steps in this treacherous land.
npc.melchior.greet_msg_1: Welcome, {}! The lovely sound of your voice shines like a beam of light through my solitary darkness!
npc.melchior.greet_msg_2: Greetings, {}. I do not see your face, but I can read a thousand things in your voice!
npc.melchior.multi_1: The djinns have an ancient code of honour. This code includes a special concept of hospitality. Anybody who utters the word of greeting must not be attacked even if he is an enemy. Well, at least that is what the code says. ...
npc.melchior.multi_2: I have found out, though, that this does not work at all times. There is no point to say the word of greeting to an enraged djinn. ...
npc.melchior.multi_3: [EN] And keep in mind that you must choose sides in this conflict. You can only follow the Efreet or the Marid - once you have made your choice there is no way back. I know from experience that djinn do not tolerate double-crossing.
npc.melchior.multi_4: And keep in mind that you must choose sides in this conflict. You can only follow the Efreet or the Marid - once you have made your choice there is no way back. I know from experience that djinn do not tolerate double-crossing.
npc.melchior.walkaway_msg_1: Farewell, stranger. May Uman the Wise guide your steps in this treacherous land.
npc.melfar.greet_msg_1: Just great, another disturbance. Just what I need.
npc.melfar.multi_1: So take this beaver bait. It will work best on dwarf trees. I'll mark the three trees on your map. Here .. here .. and here! So now mark those trees with the beaver bait. ...
npc.melfar.multi_2: If you're unlucky enough to meet one of the giant beavers, try to stay calm. Don't do any hectic moves, don't yell, don't draw any weapon, and if you should carry anything wooden on you, throw it away as far as you can.
npc.melfar.multi_3: Just great, another disturbance. Just what I need.
npc.melfar.multi_4: Ha! Men and wood you say? Well, I might be able to relocate some of our miners to the base. Acquiring wood is an entirely different matter though. ...
npc.melfar.multi_5: I can't spare any men for woodcutting right now but I have an unusual idea that might help. ...
npc.melfar.multi_6: As you might know, this area is troubled by giant beavers. Once a year, the miners decide to have some fun, so they lure the beavers and jump on them to have some sort of rodeo. ...
npc.melfar.multi_7: However, I happen to have some beaver bait left from the last year's competition. ...
npc.melfar.multi_8: If you place it on trees on some strategic locations, we could let the beavers do the work and later on, I'll send men to get the fallen trees. ...
npc.melfar.multi_9: Does this sound like something you can handle?
npc.melfar.say_1: Yes, I can hear them even from here. It has to be a legion of beavers! I'll send the men to get the wood as soon as their gnawing frenzy has settled! You can report to Ongulf that men and wood will be on their way!
npc.melfar.say_2: If you place the beaver bait on trees on some strategic locations, we could let the beavers do the work and later on, I'll send men to get the fallen trees.
npc.melfar.say_4: You dont have enough of gold coins.
npc.melfar.say_5: You want to buy a Flask with Beaver Bait for 100 gold coins?
npc.melian.greet_msg_1: Greetings, traveller |PLAYERNAME|. Where do you want me to {fly} you?
npc.melian.stdmod_1: Do you seek a ride to {0} for {1}?
npc.melian.stdmod_10: Only licensed carpet pilots are allowed to fly those.
npc.melian.stdmod_11: There's so much green stuff down there that I'm not sure whether there are any, but yes, might be, might be.
npc.melian.stdmod_12: Well, dwarves and their steamboat technology are well and good, but nothing beats flying on a carpet.
npc.melian.stdmod_13: Well, dwarves and their steamboat technology are well and good, but nothing beats flying on a carpet.
npc.melian.stdmod_14: That's the name of that dwarven base as far as I know. Got a bit of a pessimistic ring to it if you ask me. Sounds to me like they're starving.
npc.melian.stdmod_15: I can fly you to {Darashia} on {Darama}, to {Kazordoon}, to {Svargrond} on Hrodmir, to {Edron}, to the {Femor Hills}, to {Issavi} or to {Marapur} if you like. Where do you want to go?
npc.melian.stdmod_16: I can fly you to {Darashia} on {Darama}, to {Kazordoon}, to {Svargrond} on Hrodmir, to {Edron}, to the {Femor Hills}, to {Issavi} or to {Marapur} if you like. Where do you want to go?
npc.melian.stdmod_17: I can fly you to {Darashia} on {Darama}, to {Kazordoon}, to {Svargrond} on Hrodmir, to {Edron}, to the {Femor Hills}, to {Issavi} or to {Marapur} if you like. Where do you want to go?
npc.melian.stdmod_18: I can fly you to {Darashia} on {Darama}, to {Kazordoon}, to {Svargrond} on Hrodmir, to {Edron}, to the {Femor Hills}, to {Issavi} or to {Marapur} if you like. Where do you want to go?
npc.melian.stdmod_19: I can fly you to {Darashia} on {Darama}, to {Kazordoon}, to {Svargrond} on Hrodmir, to {Edron}, to the {Femor Hills}, to {Issavi} or to {Marapur} if you like. Where do you want to go?
npc.melian.stdmod_20: The only humans I've seen on this continent are those that come up to my carpet.
npc.melian.stdmod_21: What a strange and bizarre continent. I'm glad my landing place is far away from all the mess I've seen from above.
npc.melian.stdmod_22: You are probably talking about the {FEMOR hills}.
npc.melian.stdmod_23: It's 2:55 pm right now. I think I'm five minutes late in my schedule.
npc.melian.stdmod_3: There are many of them to the north and south of this continent. I had thought they only existed on Tiquanda, but I was mistaken.
npc.melian.stdmod_4: What a strange and bizarre continent. I'm glad my landing place is far away from all the mess I've seen from above.
npc.melian.stdmod_5: I can fly you to {Darashia}, {Edron}, {Issavi}, {Svargrond}, {Kazordoon}, {Femor Hills} or to {Marapur} if you like. Where do you want to go?
npc.melian.stdmod_6: I'm a carpet pilot. I can fly you to the {Femor Hills}, to {Kazordoon}, {Svargrond}, {Edron}, {Darashia}, {Issavi} or {Marapur}.
npc.melian.stdmod_7: I'm a carpet pilot. I can fly you to the {Femor Hills}, to {Kazordoon}, {Svargrond}, {Edron}, {Darashia}, {Issavi} or {Marapur}.
npc.melian.stdmod_9: These mountains don't look friendly. I prefer not staying long inbetween my carpet trips.
npc.memech.greet_msg_1: Be mourned, |PLAYERNAME|, pilgrim in flesh. Have a look at my fine {weapons} and {armors}.
npc.memech.voice_1: Selling weapons and armors to protect mortal souls.
npc.menesto.say_1: Finally, reinforcements - oh but no, you came through the crystal portal, like the others! I am ser Menesto, I guard the portal. That beast caught me by surprise, I lost my dagger and had to retreat. ...
npc.menesto.say_4: You look hungry, you should eat regularly to reagain your strength! See what you can find while hunting. Or buy food in a city shop. Here, have some of my rations, I'll take my dagger. Tell me when you're {ready}.
npc.menesto.say_5: I'll stay here till reinforcements come. Go up the ladder to reach the surface. You'll need a rope for the ropestot that comes after the ladder - here, take my spare equipment. ...
npc.menesto.say_6: And remember: Tibia is a world with many dangers and mysteries, so be careful! Farewell, friend.
npc.miles_the_guard.say_1: I'm fine. There's no trouble at all.
npc.miles_the_guard.say_2: Well, of course. We live in safety and peace.
npc.miles_the_guard.say_3: I think the gods are looking after us and their hands shield us from evil.
npc.miles_the_guard.say_4: I think the gods and the government do their best to keep away harm from the citizens.
npc.miles_the_guard.stdmod_1: It's my duty to protect the city.
npc.milos.greet_msg_1: Oh hello. I hardly noticed you. I'm afraid I am a bit distracted at the moment.
npc.mirabell.greet_msg_1: Welcome to the Horn of Plenty, |PLAYERNAME|. Sit down, have a {drink} or some {food}!
npc.mirabell.multi_1: Here they are. Wait! Two things you should know: Firstly, they won't last long in the sun so you better get them to their destination as quickly as possible ...
npc.mirabell.multi_2: Secondly, since my pies are that delicious it is forbidden to leave the town with them. We can't afford to attract more tourists to Edron.
npc.mirabell.say_1: Oh you've heard about my excellent pies, didn't you? I am flattered. Unfortunately I'm completely out of flour. I need 2 portions of flour for one pie. Just tell me when you have enough flour for your pies.
npc.mirabell.say_2: For 12 pies this is 240 gold. Do you want to buy them?
npc.mirabell.say_3: Do you bring me the flour needed for your pies?
npc.mirabell.say_4: I think you are confusing the dust in your pockets with flour. You certainly do not have enough flour for 12 pies.
npc.mirabell.say_5: Excellent. Now I can start baking the pies. As you helped me, I will make you a good price for them.
npc.mirabell.say_6: You don't have enough money, don't try to fool me.
npc.mirabell.say_7: Without flour I can't do anything, sorry.
npc.mirabell.say_8: What are you? Some kind of fool?
npc.mirabell.sendtrade_msg_1: Of course, take a look at my tasty offers.
npc.mirabell.stdmod_1: The Horn of Plenty is always open for tired adventurers.
npc.mirabell.stdmod_2: I can offer you beer, wine, lemonade and water. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.mirabell.voice_1: The Horn of Plenty is always open for tired adventurers.
npc.miraia.ape_fur_ask: Have you really managed to fulfil the task and brought me 100 pieces of ape fur?
npc.miraia.ape_fur_done: Ahhh, this softness! I'm impressed, |PLAYERNAME|. You're on the best way to earn that turban. Now, please retrieve 100 fish fins.
npc.miraia.ape_fur_info: Only ape fur is good enough to touch the feet of our Caliph.
npc.miraia.blue_cloth_ask: Ah, have you brought the 100 pieces of blue cloth?
npc.miraia.blue_cloth_done: Ah! Congratulations - I hope this veil will turn out as beautiful as you are. Here, I'll do it for you.
npc.miraia.blue_cloth_info: It's a great material for turbans.
npc.miraia.chicken_wings_ask: Were you able to get hold of two enchanted chicken wings?
npc.miraia.chicken_wings_done: Great, thank you very much. Just bring me 100 pieces of blue cloth now and I will happily show you how to make a turban.
npc.miraia.chicken_wings_info: Enchanted chicken wings are actually used to make boots of haste, so they could be magically extracted again. Djinns are said to be good at that.
npc.miraia.fish_fins_ask: Were you able to discover the undersea race and retrieved 100 fish fins?
npc.miraia.fish_fins_done: I never thought you'd make it, |PLAYERNAME|. Now we only need two enchanted chicken wings to start our waterwalking test!
npc.miraia.fish_fins_info: I really wonder what the explorer society is up to. Actually I have no idea how they managed to dive unterwater.
npc.miraia.greet_msg_1: Daraman's blessings, |PLAYERNAME|. Welcome to the Enlightened Oasis. Sit down, have a {drink} or some {food}!
npc.miraia.multi_1: Alright, then listen to the following requirements. We are currently in dire need of ape fur since the Caliph has requested a new bathroom carpet. ...
npc.miraia.multi_2: Thus, please bring me 100 pieces of ape fur. Secondly, it came to our ears that the explorer society has discovered a new undersea race of fishmen. ...
npc.miraia.multi_3: Their fins are said to allow humans to walk on water! Please bring us 100 of these fish fin. ...
npc.miraia.multi_4: Third, if the plan of walking on water should fail, we need enchanted chicken wings to prevent the testers from drowning. Please bring me two. ...
npc.miraia.multi_5: Last but not least, just drop by with 100 pieces of blue cloth and I will happily show you how to make a turban. ...
npc.miraia.multi_6: Did you understand everything I told you and are willing to handle this task?
npc.miraia.say_1: Hehe, would you like to wear a pretty veil like I do? Well... I could help you, but you would have to complete a task first.
npc.miraia.say_2: You mean, you would like to prove that you deserve to wear such a veil?
npc.miraia.say_3: Let me cover my nose before I get this for you... Would you REALLY like to buy scarab cheese for 100 gold?
npc.miraia.say_4: Oh the last cheese molded? Would you like to buy another one for 100 gold?
npc.miraia.say_5: Excellent! Come back to me once you have collected 100 pieces of ape fur.
npc.miraia.stdmod_1: I can offer you lemonade, camel milk, and water. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.miraia.stdmod_2: Are you looking for food? I have bread, cheese, ham, and meat. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.moe.greet_msg_1: Greetings, traveller. It seems, you're a {guest} here, just like me.
npc.moe.say_1: I guess I could do this, yes. But I have to impose a condition. If you bring me ten sphinx feathers I will steal this ring for you.
npc.moe.say_10: You already know about the lyre's location.
npc.moe.say_2: Thank you! They look so pretty, I'm very pleased. Agreed, now I will steal the ring from the Ambassador of Rathleton. Just be patient, I have to wait for a good moment.
npc.moe.say_3: If you bring me ten sphinx feathers, I will steal this ring for you.
npc.moe.say_4: You already delivered the feathers. Be patient while I steal the ring.
npc.moe.say_5: You're arriving at the right time. I have the ring you asked for. It was not too difficult. I just had to wait until the Ambassador left his residence and then I climbed in through the window. Here it is.
npc.moe.say_6: I will steal it, promised. I'm just waiting for a good moment.
npc.moe.say_7: I guess I could do this, yes. But I have to impose a condition. If you bring me ten sphinx feathers I will steal this ring for you.
npc.moe.say_8: You don't need this ring anymore.
npc.moe.say_9: I'm upset to accuse myself, the lyre is hidden in a tomb west of Kilmaresh.
npc.moe.voice_1: The menu of the day sounds delicious!
npc.moe.voice_2: The last visit to the theatre was quite rewarding.
npc.moe.voice_3: Such a beautiful and wealthy city - with so many opportunities ...
npc.mordecai.greet_msg_1: Welcome to the magic emporium, child. Ask me for a trade if you need {runes}, {wands}, or spellbooks.
npc.mordecai.say_1: Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
npc.mordecai.voice_1: Come in, young mages! Purchase the latest in runes and wands!
npc.mordecai.voice_2: Perhaps I need to bake them hotter? Or was it longer?
npc.mordecai.voice_3: Offering all sorts of magic equipment!
npc.mordecai.voice_4: Now where did Alaistar put the wood for the new wands?
npc.mordecai.voice_5: Hmmm.. Maybe those crushed gems caused the strange side effect?
npc.mordecai.voice_6: Wands and rods, the true magician's weapons of choice!
npc.morgan.multi_1: Hm, if you are that eager to work I have an idea how you could help me out. A distant relative of mine, the old sage Eremo lives on the isle Cormaya, near Edron. ...
npc.morgan.multi_2: He has not heard from me since ages. He might assume that I am dead. Since I don't want him to get into trouble for receiving a letter from a pirate I ask you to deliver it personally. ...
npc.morgan.multi_3: Of course it's a long journey but you asked for it. You will have to prove us your worth. Are you up to that?
npc.morgan.say_1: Ahh. So Duncan sent you, eh? You must have done something really impressive. Okay, take this fine sabre from me, mate.
npc.morgan.say_10: You do not have all the required items.
npc.morgan.say_11: What would you like me to forge for you? A {knight's sword} or a {warrior's sword}?
npc.morgan.say_12: Alright, we will see. Here, take this letter and deliver it safely to old Eremo on Cormaya.
npc.morgan.say_2: Thank you for delivering my letter to Eremo. I have no more missions for you.
npc.morgan.say_4: Great! Simply bring me 100 iron ore and one royal steel and I will happily {forge} it for you.
npc.morgan.say_5: Alright! As a matter of fact, I have one in store. Here you go!
npc.morgan.say_6: You do not have all the required items.
npc.morgan.say_8: Great! Simply bring me 100 Iron Ore and one Crude Iron and I will happily {forge} it for you.
npc.morgan.say_9: Alright! As a matter of fact, I have one in store. Here you go!
npc.morgan.stdmod_1: I can forge the finest {weapons} for knights and warriors. They may wear them proudly and visible to everyone.
npc.morgan.stdmod_2: Would you rather be interested in a {knight's sword} or in a {warrior's sword}?
npc.mortimer.multi_1: Our members travel to far away places and cross dangerous areas, many fall prey to enemies or the land ...
npc.mortimer.multi_10: Fine. The society is looking for new means to travel. Some of our most brilliant minds have some theories about astral travel that they want to research further ...
npc.mortimer.multi_11: Therefore we need you to collect some ectoplasm from the corpse of a ghost. We will supply you with a collector that you can use on the body of a slain ghost ...
npc.mortimer.multi_12: Do you think you are ready for that mission?
npc.mortimer.multi_13: You are a brave soul. As far as we can tell, the orcs maintain some sort of training facility in some hill in the north-east of their city ...
npc.mortimer.multi_14: There you should find lots of their war wolves and hopefully also some of the orcish powder. Good luck!
npc.mortimer.multi_15: Excellent! So travel to the city of Darashia and then head north-east for the pyramid ...
npc.mortimer.multi_16: If any documents are left, you probably find them in the catacombs beneath. Good luck!
npc.mortimer.multi_17: You have indeed the spirit of an adventurer! In the south-east of Tiquanda is a small settlement of the lizard people ...
npc.mortimer.multi_18: Beneath the newly constructed temple there, the lizards hide the said urn. Our attempts to acquire this item were without success ...
npc.mortimer.multi_2: Sometimes the personal explorer brooches can be recovered. That way we learn about the fate of our members ...
npc.mortimer.multi_20: This preparation kit will allow you to collect a purple butterfly you have killed ...
npc.mortimer.multi_21: Just use it on the fresh corpse of a purple butterfly, return the prepared butterfly to me and give me a report of your butterfly hunt.
npc.mortimer.multi_22: So listen please: Take this ice pick and use it on a block of ice in the caves beneath Folda. Get some ice and bring it here as fast as you can ...
npc.mortimer.multi_23: Should the ice melt away, report on your ice delivery mission anyway. I will then tell you if the time is right to start another mission.
npc.mortimer.multi_24: Excellent, you brought just the tool we need! Of course it was only a simple task. However ...
npc.mortimer.multi_25: I officially welcome you to the explorer society. From now on you can ask for missions to improve your rank.
npc.mortimer.multi_26: Fine, though it takes more then a mere lip service to join our ranks. To prove your dedication to the cause you will have to acquire an item for us ...
npc.mortimer.multi_27: The mission should be simple to fulfil. For our excavations we have ordered a sturdy pickaxe in Kazordoon. You would have to seek out this trader Uzgod and get the pickaxe for us ...
npc.mortimer.multi_28: Simple enough? Are you interested in this task?
npc.mortimer.multi_29: We would like to study some ancient runes that were used by the lizard race. We suspect some relation of the lizards to the founders of Ankrahmun ...
npc.mortimer.multi_3: We offer a reward for each brooch returned to us. Have you found an explorer brooch?
npc.mortimer.multi_30: Somewhere under the ape infested city of Banuta, one can find dungeons that were once inhabited by lizards...
npc.mortimer.multi_31: Look there for an atypical structure that would rather fit to Ankrahmun and its Ankrahmun Tombs. Copy the runes you will find on this structure...
npc.mortimer.multi_32: Are you up to that challenge?
npc.mortimer.multi_33: We acquired some knowledge about special magic stones. Some lost civilisations used it to store knowledge and lore, just like we use books ...
npc.mortimer.multi_34: The wisdom in such stones must be immense, but so are the dangers faced by every person who tries to obtain one...
npc.mortimer.multi_35: As far as we know the ruins found in the north-west of Edron were once inhabited by beings who used such stones. Do you have the heart to go there and to get us such a stone?
npc.mortimer.multi_36: Some high ranking members would like to study elven poetry. They want the rare book 'Songs of the Forest' ...
npc.mortimer.multi_37: For sure someone in Ab'Dendriel will own a copy. So you would just have to ask around there. Are you willing to accept this mission?
npc.mortimer.multi_38: It is commonly known that orcs of Uldereks Rock use some sort of powder to increase the fierceness of their war wolves and berserkers ...
npc.mortimer.multi_39: What we do not know are the ingredients of this powder and its effect on humans ...
npc.mortimer.multi_4: Ratha was a great explorer and even greater ladies' man. Sadly he never returned from a visit to the amazons. Probably he is dead ...
npc.mortimer.multi_40: So we would like you to get a sample of the aforesaid powder. Do you want to accept this mission?
npc.mortimer.multi_41: We want to learn more about the ancient race of bonelords. We believe the black pyramid north east of Darashia was originally built by them ...
npc.mortimer.multi_42: We ask you to explore the ruins of the black pyramid and look for any signs that prove our theory. You might probably find some document with the numeric bonelord language ...
npc.mortimer.multi_43: That would be sufficient proof. Would you like to accept this mission?
npc.mortimer.multi_44: This preparation kit will allow you to collect a red butterfly you have killed ...
npc.mortimer.multi_45: Just use it on the fresh corpse of a red butterfly, return the prepared butterfly to me and give me a report of your butterfly hunt.
npc.mortimer.multi_46: This preparation kit will allow you to collect a blue butterfly you have killed ...
npc.mortimer.multi_47: Just use it on the fresh corpse of a blue butterfly, return the prepared butterfly to me and give me a report of your butterfly hunt.
npc.mortimer.multi_48: Our finest minds came up with the theory that deep beneath the ice island of Folda ice can be found that is ancient. To prove this theory we would need a sample of the aforesaid ice ...
npc.mortimer.multi_49: Of course the ice melts away quickly so you would need to hurry to bring it here ...
npc.mortimer.multi_5: The society offers a substantial reward for the retrieval of Ratha or his remains. Do you have any news about Ratha?
npc.mortimer.multi_50: Would you like to accept this mission?
npc.mortimer.multi_51: Both carvings are now charged and harmonised. In theory you should be able to travel in zero time from one base to the other ...
npc.mortimer.multi_52: However, you will need to have an orichalcum pearl in your possession to use it as power source. It will be destroyed during the process. I will give you 6 of such pearls and you can buy new ones in our bases ...
npc.mortimer.multi_53: In addition, you need to be a premium explorer to use the astral travel. ...
npc.mortimer.multi_54: And remember: it's a small teleport for you, but a big teleport for all Tibians! Here is a small present for your efforts!
npc.mortimer.multi_55: With the objects you've provided our researchers will make steady progress. Still we are missing some test results from fellow explorers ...
npc.mortimer.multi_56: Please travel to our base in Port Hope and ask them to mail us their latest research reports. Then return here and ask about new missions.
npc.mortimer.multi_57: The research on ectoplasm makes good progress. Now we need some spectral article. Our scientists think a spectral dress would be a perfect object for their studies ...
npc.mortimer.multi_58: The bad news is that the only source to got such a dress is the queen of the banshees. Do you dare to seek her out?
npc.mortimer.multi_59: Those stories are just amazing! Men with faces on their stomach instead of heads you say? And hens that lay golden eggs? Whereas, most amazing is this fountain of youth you've mentioned! ...
npc.mortimer.multi_6: Good, just take this spectral essence and use it on the strange carving in this building as well as on the corresponding tile in our base at Northport ...
npc.mortimer.multi_60: I'll immediately send some of our most dedicated explorers to check those things out!
npc.mortimer.multi_7: As soon as you have charged the portal tiles that way, report about the spectral portals.
npc.mortimer.multi_8: That is quite courageous. We know, it's much we are asking for. The queen of the banshees lives in the so called Ghostlands, south west of Carlin. It is rumoured that her lair is located in the deepest dungeons beneath that cursed place ...
npc.mortimer.multi_9: Any violence will probably be futile, you will have to negotiate with her. Try to get a spectral dress from her. Good luck.
npc.mortimer.say_1: Do you want to join the explorer society?
npc.mortimer.say_10: The reports from Port Hope have already arrived here and our progress is astonishing. We think it is possible to create an astral bridge between our bases. Are you interested to assist us with this?
npc.mortimer.say_11: Did you get the requested pickaxe from Uzgod in Kazordoon?
npc.mortimer.say_12: Did you get the ice we are looking for?
npc.mortimer.say_13: The mission asks you to collect some species of butterflies, are you interested?
npc.mortimer.say_14: Did you acquire the purple butterfly we are looking for?
npc.mortimer.say_15: Did you acquire the blue butterfly we are looking for?
npc.mortimer.say_16: Did you acquire the red butterfly we are looking for?
npc.mortimer.say_17: In this mission we require you to get us some plant samples from Tiquandan plants. Would you like to fulfil this mission?
npc.mortimer.say_18: Did you acquire the sample of the jungle bells plant we are looking for?
npc.mortimer.say_19: Use this botanist's container on a witches cauldron to collect a sample for us. Bring it here and report about your plant collection.
npc.mortimer.say_2: Oh yes, an interesting topic. We had vivid discussions about this discovery. But what is it that you want?
npc.mortimer.say_20: Did you acquire the sample of the witches cauldron we are looking for?
npc.mortimer.say_21: Use this botanist's container on a giant jungle rose to obtain a sample for us. Bring it here and report about your plant collection.
npc.mortimer.say_22: Did you acquire the sample of the giant jungle rose we are looking for?
npc.mortimer.say_23: The explorer society would like to acquire an ancient urn which is some sort of relic to the lizard people of Tiquanda. Would you like to accept this mission?
npc.mortimer.say_24: Did you manage to get the ancient urn?
npc.mortimer.say_25: Have you found any proof that the pyramid was built by bonelords?
npc.mortimer.say_26: Did you acquire some of the orcish powder?
npc.mortimer.say_27: Did you acquire a copy of 'Songs of the Forest' for us?
npc.mortimer.say_28: Were you able to acquire a memory stone for our society?
npc.mortimer.say_29: Did you create a copy of the ancient runes as requested?
npc.mortimer.say_3: The missions available for your rank are the {butterfly hunt}, {plant collection} and {ice delivery}.
npc.mortimer.say_30: We will see if you can handle this simple task. Get the pickaxe from Uzgod in Kazordoon and bring it to one of our bases. Report there about the pickaxe.
npc.mortimer.say_31: Just in time. Sadly not much ice is left over but it will do. Thank you again.
npc.mortimer.say_32: *Sigh* I think the time is right to grant you another chance to get that ice. Hurry up this time.
npc.mortimer.say_33: A little bit battered but it will do. Thank you! If you think you are ready, ask for another butterfly hunt.
npc.mortimer.say_34: A little bit battered but it will do. Thank you! If you think you are ready, ask for another butterfly hunt.
npc.mortimer.say_35: That is an extraordinary species you have brought. Thank you! That was the last butterfly we needed.
npc.mortimer.say_36: Fine! Here take this botanist's container. Use it on a jungle bells plant to collect a sample for us. Report about your plant collection when you have been successful.
npc.mortimer.say_37: I see. It seems you've got some quite useful sample by sheer luck. Thank you! Just tell me when you are ready to continue with the plant collection.
npc.mortimer.say_38: Ah, finally. I started to wonder what took you so long. But thank you! Another fine sample, indeed. Just tell me when you are ready to continue with the plant collection.
npc.mortimer.say_39: What a lovely sample! With that you have finished your plant collection missions.
npc.mortimer.say_4: The missions available for your rank are {lizard urn}, {bonelord secrets} and {orc powder}.
npc.mortimer.say_40: Yes, that is the prized relic we have been looking for so long. You did a great job, thank you.
npc.mortimer.say_41: You did it! Excellent! The scientific world will be shaken by this discovery!
npc.mortimer.say_42: You really got it? Amazing! Thank you for your efforts.
npc.mortimer.say_43: Excellent. This mission is easy but nonetheless vital. Travel to Ab'Dendriel and get the book.
npc.mortimer.say_44: Let me have a look! Yes, that's what we wanted. A copy of 'Songs of the Forest'. I won't ask any questions about those bloodstains.
npc.mortimer.say_45: In the ruins of north-western Edron you should be able to find a memory stone. Good luck.
npc.mortimer.say_46: A flawless memory stone! Incredible! It will take years even to figure out how it works but what an opportunity for science, thank you!
npc.mortimer.say_47: Excellent! Here, take this tracing paper and use it on the object you will find there to create a copy of the ancient runes.
npc.mortimer.say_48: It's a bit wrinkled but it will do. Thanks again.
npc.mortimer.say_49: Good! Take this container and use it on a ghost that was recently slain. Return with the collected ectoplasm and hand me that container ...
npc.mortimer.say_5: The missions available for your rank are {elven poetry}, {memory stone} and {rune writings}.
npc.mortimer.say_50: Don't lose the container. They are expensive!
npc.mortimer.say_51: Phew, I had no idea that ectoplasm would smell that ... oh, it's you, well, sorry. Thank you for the ectoplasm.
npc.mortimer.say_52: Good! Ask me for another mission.
npc.mortimer.say_53: Poor Ratha. Thank you for returning this skull to the society. We will see to a honourable burial of Ratha.
npc.mortimer.say_54: Come back when you find any information.
npc.mortimer.say_55: Marvellous! You brought a giant smith hammer for the explorer society!
npc.mortimer.say_57: It's always a sad day when we learn about the death of a member. But at least we learnt about his fate. Thank you, here is your reward.
npc.mortimer.say_59: Come back when you find any information.
npc.mortimer.say_6: The explorer society needs a great deal of help in the research of astral travel. Are you willing to help?
npc.mortimer.say_60: Come back when you find one.
npc.mortimer.say_61: The explorer society is looking for a genuine giant smith hammer for our collection. It is rumoured the cyclopses of the Plains of Havoc might be using one. Did you by chance obtain such a hammer?
npc.mortimer.say_7: Do you have some collected ectoplasm with you?
npc.mortimer.say_9: Oh, yes! Tell our fellow explorer that the papers are in the mail already.
npc.mother_of_jack.greet_msg_1: I demand an explanation of you entering our house without any invitation.
npc.mother_of_jack.multi_1: Oh my... he did what? Why was he there? Edron Academy? ...
npc.mother_of_jack.multi_2: I see... this cannot be. Spectrofuss? Who? Jack! When? How? But why did he do that? Jack!! JACK!! When I find him he owes me an EXPLANATION. Thanks for telling me what he is actually doing in his FREE TIME. ...
npc.mother_of_jack.say_1: What about him? He's downstairs as he always has been. He never went away from home any further than into the forest nearby. He rarely ever took a walk to Edron, did he?
npc.mother_of_jack.say_2: Thought so. Of course he wouldn't do anything wrong. And he went where? Edron. Hm. I can see nothing wrong with that. But... he wasn't there often, was he?
npc.mother_of_jack.say_3: What...? But he wasn't up to something, was he?
npc.mother_of_jack.voice_2: Oh dear, I can't find anything in here!
npc.mother_of_jack.voice_3: There is still some dust on the drawer over there. What where you thinking, Jane?
npc.mr._west.greet_msg_1: Wh .. What? How did you get here? Where are all the guards? You .. you could have killed me but yet you chose to talk? What a relief! ...
npc.mr._west.greet_msg_2: So what brings you here my friend, if I might call you like that?
npc.mr._west.greet_msg_3: Murderer! But .. I give in, you won!
npc.mr._west.greet_msg_4: Dictate me your conditions but please, I beg you, spare my life. What do you want?
npc.mr._west.say_1: Indeed, I can see the benefits of a mutual agreement. I will later read the details and send a letter to your superior.
npc.mr._west.say_2: Yes, for the sake of my life I'll accept those terms. I know when I have lost. Tell your master I will comply with his orders.
npc.mr._west.say_3: Indeed, I can see the benefits of a mutual agreement. I will later read the details and send a letter to your superior.
npc.mr._west.say_4: Yes, for the sake of my life I'll accept those terms. I know when I have lost. Tell your master I will comply with his orders.
npc.mr_brandon.voice_1: <grumble> Maybe I should rearrange some warm currents to get rid of this horrible fog.
npc.mr_brandon.voice_2: All these treasures I cannot reach... what a pity.
npc.mr_morris.greet_msg_1: Welcome, young adventurer. \z If you seek to help me with some things, I might have a little {quest} or {mission} for you.
npc.mr_morris.say_1: One of our ...less fortunate members lost an ancient amulet somewhere on the island, along with his life. If you could retrieve the amulet at least, there's a little reward. Would you go on that errand?
npc.mr_morris.say_10: I will reward you if you kill 20 minotaur bruisers. Would you do that?
npc.mr_morris.say_11: The first log book from the first foray group has been stolen by trolls. One wonders what for, as they can hardly read! Anyway, we need it back. Would you go looking for it?
npc.mr_morris.say_12: Ah, yes, that's it! Torn and gnawed, but, ah well, the information is still retrievable. Thank you. Here's your reward.
npc.mr_morris.say_13: Some of those salamanders have crawled into Oressa's herb garden and munched all her Dawnfire herbs. Would you get some fresh herbs?
npc.mr_morris.say_14: Ah, wonderful. Freshly cut and full of potent... whatever it is it does. Thanks. Here's your reward.
npc.mr_morris.say_15: This is an undercover thing - the key to the dormitory has disappeared. No one wants to own up who has lost it, at least not to me. Maybe they'll talk to you. I'll reward you if you find it. You in?
npc.mr_morris.say_16: Wonderful. I don't believe you will find Dormovo alive, though. He would not have stayed abroad that long without refilling his inkpot for his research notes. But at least the amulet should be retrieved.
npc.mr_morris.say_17: Good. The logbook or whatever is left of it is very valuable to my research. If you return its contents to me, I will reward you accordingly.
npc.mr_morris.say_18: Good. Killing 20 will teach them a lesson, without provoking desperate retaliation. Still, take care!
npc.mr_morris.say_19: Ah, you're here to report about the {key} - any progress?
npc.mr_morris.say_2: Ah, you found the amulet! Ah. Really? Poor Dormovo. Always a bit hasty. Forgot his rope, or food, or potions - it was to be expected he would meet an early end. Oh, well. ...
npc.mr_morris.say_20: Good. Just chat with the guys. Someone is bound to remember *something* about that key.
npc.mr_morris.say_21: The key to the dormitory! Finally! You're a real sleuth. Here's your reward.
npc.mr_morris.say_22: Ah, very good job. That should put a crimp in their activities. Here's your reward.
npc.mr_morris.say_23: Come back when you have slain {20 mountain trolls!}
npc.mr_morris.say_24: Ah, very good job. That should put a crimp in their activities. Here's your reward.
npc.mr_morris.say_25: Come back when you have slain {20 muglex clan footman!}
npc.mr_morris.say_26: Ah, very good job. That should put a crimp in their activities. Here's your reward.
npc.mr_morris.say_27: Come back when you have slain {20 minotaur bruisers!}
npc.mr_morris.say_3: Splendid. Those Dawnfire buds are just the thing against nasty troll bites, you know? But they're quite rare.
npc.mr_morris.say_4: Look for a bush with yellow glowing flower buds. It grows only on a special, light grey-brown sand, and is usually surrounded by fireflies. Use the herb to pluck off the fresh flower buds, and return to me.
npc.mr_morris.say_5: Mountain trolls are worse than magpies, stealing everything that's not nailed down. Lately, they have raided our ship and made off with most of the Captain's rum stock!
npc.mr_morris.say_6: I will reward you if you kill 20 mountain trolls. Would you do that?
npc.mr_morris.say_7: Footmen of the muglex clan are worse than magpies, stealing everything that's not nailed down. Lately, they have raided our ship and made off with most of the Captain's rum stock!
npc.mr_morris.say_8: I will reward you if you kill 20 muglex clan footmen. Would you do that?
npc.mr_morris.say_9: Minotaur bruisers are worse than magpies, stealing everything that's not nailed down. Lately, they have raided our ship and made off with most of the Captain's rum stock!
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_1: I have a quest that needs doing. Interested?
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_10:
Hm. Well, you look like you want to take a look at the unknown yourself. \z
			I might have a job for you. Choose what you would like to do - {fetch} some things, or {kill} some monsters.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_11:
There's three things that need to be found. You can look for an {amulet}, \z
			a {log book} or pick some rare {herbs}. Take your pick.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_12:
Well, those monsters have grown very uppity lately. There's a choice of three - mountain {trolls}, \z
			muglex clan {goblins} or, if you are up to it or together with some friends, \z
			there's a need to weed out some risky {minotaur} bruisers. Choose your target.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_14:
There's always someone who needs to be at the front, to take the first step into the unknown. \z
			My whole life has been full of such steps.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_15:
Ah, that old story of how it was named? I spread it around. \z
			Can't remember really what its origins are. Interesting archeological findings here, though.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_16:
Ah yes. Well, the magic that led us here seems to be most potent at a certain time, close before sunrise. \z
			Perhaps like a giant pulse, or beacon. Maybe the gods set it here, or a mad sorcerer, \z
			we don't know for sure yet... The portal deep down in the caves, resonating with magical energy where you came \z
			through, can maybe bring something else into this world as well. \z
			So it must be carefully guarded while we investigate the island for more clues... \z
			There are some very interesting archeological findings here on the island throughout. \z
			Seems the island has drawn some cults here, but why they are gone now, no one knows.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_17:
It seems that throughout its history, this island was inhabited by very different species. \z
			I like to study their remains.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_18:
Yeah. Long time I haven't been to that place. How's old Vascalir? Still hanging around in the academy? \z
			And Kraknaknork? Hah, I remember our brawl after that last card game. Fun times.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_19:
What about him? Is he in one of his dark moods again? That's his normal mood, I mean. \z
			Just buy your armor, weaponry and ammunition there and don't worry.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_2: Hmmm. Interesting. If only someone could help investigate this.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_20: Tired of the academy, maybe, but not of teaching. If you need druid or sorcerer spells, go to him.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_21:
Ah, good old Hamish. A real wizard with potions. \z
			Will supply you with very useful magic equipment for hunting.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_3: There's a task for an intrepid adventurer open! Any volunteers?
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_4: Hey, you. Yes, you. I could use your help.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_5:
<sigh> The Adventurers' Guild really should have equipped me with more man power. \z
		Who's to keep all those monsters in check?
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_6: So much to investigate, so little time...
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_7: Buying all sorts of creature products!
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_8: You're looking thoughtful. Maybe I can help you?

npc.muhad.farewell_msg_1: May Daraman be with you on your travels.
npc.muhad.greet_msg_1: Be greeted, foreigner under the sun of Darama. What brings you {here}?
npc.muhad.multi_1: I appreciate your will to help the sons of the desert. Recently a bunch of thieves have stolen something very valuable from us. It is a secret the true sons kept for aeons and I am not allowed to tell you about it. ...
npc.muhad.multi_2: [EN] If you press the eye of the hawk symbol a secret passage will appear that leads to their hideout. Once inside you have to look for a small casket. ...
npc.muhad.multi_3: [EN] Try to sneak in undetectedly and bring back our treasure as soon as you obtain it. May Daraman hold his protective hand over you on your mission. I wish you good luck. ...
npc.muhad.multi_4: [EN] One last thing before you leave. Take the path behind me and you will get out of our hideout unharmed.
npc.muhad.multi_5: One last thing before you leave. Take the path behind me and you will get out of our hideout unharmed.
npc.muhad.multi_6: Ahh, I know that some of my people fear that Arito tells the old secrets of our race and want to see him dead but I don't bear him a grudge. I will have to have a serious word with my people. ...
npc.muhad.multi_7: Tell him that he can consider himself as acquitted. He is not the reason for our attacks towards {Ankrahmun}.
npc.muhad.multi_8: [EN] In the wink of an eye he left us and was never seen again. I think he feared revenge for leaving us - which partially is not without reason. Why are you asking me about him? Did he send you to me?
npc.muhad.multi_9: In the wink of an eye he left us and was never seen again. I think he feared revenge for leaving us - which partially is not without reason. Why are you asking me about him? Did he send you to me?
npc.muhad.stdmod_1: I am the leader of the true sons of {Daraman}.
npc.muhad.stdmod_2: I am the leader of the true sons of {Daraman}.
npc.muhad.stdmod_3: This is our home - the land of the desert.
npc.muhad.stdmod_4: We will fight that city until we get back what belongs to us.
npc.muhad.stdmod_5: We avoid these places you call cities.
npc.muhad.stdmod_6: I would go crazy living in a cage like that.
npc.muhad.stdmod_7: We have nothing that would be of value for you.
npc.muhad.stdmod_8: That is the curse for not following the rules of the desert. No son of the desert has ever come back from the dead.
npc.muhad.stdmod_9: We have nothing that would be of value for you.
npc.muhad.walkaway_msg_1: May Daraman be with you on your travels.
npc.muriel.greet_msg_1: Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! Looking for wisdom and power, eh?
npc.muriel.multi_1: Great! Here is the container for the bone. Once, I used it to collect ectoplasma of ghosts, but it will work here as well. ...
npc.muriel.multi_2: If you lose it, you can buy a new one from the explorer's society in North Port or Port Hope. Ask me about the mission when you come back.
npc.muriel.multi_3: I am so glad you are still alive. Benjamin found the container with the bone sample inside. Fortunately, I inscribe everything with my name, so he knew it was mine. ...
npc.muriel.multi_4: I thought you have been haunted and killed by the undead. I'm glad that this is not the case. Thank you for your help.
npc.muriel.multi_5: The rotworms dug deep into the soil north of Thais. Rumours say that you can access a place of endless moaning from there. ...
npc.muriel.multi_6: No one knows how old that common grave is but the people who died there are cursed and never come to rest. A bone from that pit would be perfect for my studies.
npc.muriel.multi_7: Indeed, there is something you can do for me. You must know I am researching for a new spell against the undead. ...
npc.muriel.multi_8: To achieve that I need a desecrated bone. There is a cursed bone pit somewhere in the dungeons north of Thais where the dead never rest. ...
npc.muriel.multi_9: Find that pit, dig for a well-preserved human skeleton and conserve a sample in a special container which you receive from me. Are you going to help me?
npc.muriel.say_1: Indeed there is something to be done, but I need someone more experienced. Come back later if you want to.
npc.muriel.say_10: Oh, sorry but you don't have enough colourful feathers!
npc.muriel.say_11: I provide two addons. For the first one I need you to bring me three porcelain masks. For the second addon you need fifty colourful ostrich feathers. Do you want one of these addons?
npc.muriel.say_12: What do you have for me: the porcelain masks or the colourful feathers?
npc.muriel.say_13: I provide two addons. For the first one I need you to bring me three porcelain masks. For the second addon you need fifty colourful ostrich feathers. Do you want one of these addons?
npc.muriel.say_14: Ohh, then I need to find another adventurer who wants to earn a great reward. Bye!
npc.muriel.say_2: Excellent! Now I can try to put my theoretical thoughts into practice and find a cure for the symptoms of undead. Here, take this for your efforts.
npc.muriel.say_3: I am very glad you helped me, but I am very busy at the moment.
npc.muriel.say_4: I see you have the porcelain masks. Are you ready to exchange them for the first addon?
npc.muriel.say_5: I see you have the colourful feathers. Are you ready to exchange them for the second addon?
npc.muriel.say_6: You need the outfit and 3 porcelain masks or 50 colored feathers to get the festive costume accessories.
npc.muriel.say_7: Very good! You gained the first addon to the festive outfit.
npc.muriel.say_8: Oh, sorry but you don't have enough porcelain masks!
npc.muriel.say_9: Very good! You gained the second addon to the festive outfit.

npc.myra.greet_msg_1: Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|. If you are looking for sorcerer {spells} don't hesitate to ask.
npc.myra.multi_1: Okay, great! You see, I need a few magical ingredients which I've run out of. First of all, please bring me 70 bat wings. ...
npc.myra.multi_2: Then, I urgently need a lot of red cloth. I think 20 pieces should suffice. ...
npc.myra.multi_3: Oh, and also, I could use a whole load of ape fur. Please bring me 40 pieces. ...
npc.myra.multi_4: After that, um, let me think... I'd like to have some holy orchids. Or no, many holy orchids, to be safe. Like 35. ...
npc.myra.multi_5: Then, 10 spools of spider silk yarn, 60 lizard scales and 40 red dragon scales. ...
npc.myra.multi_6: I know I'm forgetting something.. wait... ah yes, 15 ounces of magic sulphur and 30 ounces of vampire dust. ...
npc.myra.multi_7: That's it already! Easy task, isn't it? I'm sure you could get all of that within a short time. ...
npc.myra.multi_8: Did you understand everything I told you and are willing to handle this task?

npc.myra.say_20: Thank you! I really needed them for my anti-wrinkle lotion. Now, please bring me 20 pieces of red cloth.
npc.myra.say_21: Would you like me to repeat the task requirements then?
npc.myra.say_22: No, no. That's not enough, I fear.
npc.myra.say_23: Great! This should be enough for my new dress. Don't forget to bring me 40 pieces of ape fur next!
npc.myra.say_24: Would you like me to repeat the task requirements then?
npc.myra.say_25: No, no. That's not enough, I fear.
npc.myra.say_26: Nice job, player. You see, I'm testing a new depilation cream. I guess if it works on ape fur it's good quality. Next, please bring me 35 holy orchids.
npc.myra.say_27: Would you like me to repeat the task requirements then?
npc.myra.say_28: No, no. That's not enough, I fear.
npc.myra.say_29: Thank god! The scent of holy orchids is simply the only possible solution against the horrible stench from the tavern latrine. Now, please bring me 10 rolls of spider silk yarn.
npc.myra.say_3: Well... maybe, if you help me a little, I could convince the academy of Edron that you are a valuable help here and deserve an award too. How about it?
npc.myra.say_30: Would you like me to repeat the task requirements then?
npc.myra.say_31: No, no. That's not enough, I fear.
npc.myra.say_32: I appreciate it. My pet doggie manages to bite through all sorts of leashes, which is why he is always gone. I'm sure this strong yarn will keep him. Now, go for the 60 lizard scales!
npc.myra.say_33: Would you like me to repeat the task requirements then?

npc.myzzi.greet_msg_1: Hello adventurer. It is {good} to see you.
npc.myzzi.multi_1: I know only little and I forget so much. So many things going around my mind! ...
npc.myzzi.multi_2: However, I can grant you access to the {Courts} of Summer and Winter if you promise to help! There you can meet with Undal or Vanys, the servants of Lord Cadion and Lady Alivar. They will be able to tell you more about the issue.
npc.myzzi.say_1: I'm just a mere messenger and I'm here to find brave adventurers that might {help} my friends in this time of need.
npc.myzzi.say_10: However, I can grant you access to the {Courts} of Summer and Winter if you promise to help! There you can meet with Undal or Vanys, the servants of Lord Cadion and Lady Alivar. They will be able to tell you more about the issue.
npc.myzzi.say_11: There are {entrances} to the hidden Courts of Summer and Winter in secluded places. You can find the portal to the Winter Court high in the mountains of Tyrsung and the portal to the Summer Court in the meadows of Feyrist. ...
npc.myzzi.say_12: With my magic you will be able to enter the Courts. Find Undal or Vanys and talk to them.
npc.myzzi.say_13: So, are you willing to help in this time of need?
npc.myzzi.say_14: You are a true hero! Here, take my enchantment and you will be able to pass the portals. Now hurry, my friends are waiting.

npc.nah_bob.farewell_msg_1: Bye now, Neutrala |PLAYERNAME|. Visit old Bob again one day!
npc.nah_bob.multi_2: |PLAYERNAME|, that almost sounded like the word of greeting. Humans - cute they are!
npc.nah_bob.say_1: Whoa! A human! This is no place for you, |PLAYERNAME|. Go and play somewhere else.
npc.nah_bob.say_2: <Sighs> Another {customer}! I've only just sat down! What is it, |PLAYERNAME|?

npc.naji.voice_1: It's a wise idea to store your money in your bank account.
npc.narsai.say_1: Could you help me do a ritual?
npc.narsai.say_2: Here is the list of ingredients that are missing to complete the ritual.

npc.navigator.multi_1: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
npc.navigator.multi_10: And then I laid my eyes on a creature I have never seen before. I now know that they call themselves Njey. You would call them the 'Creatures of the Deep' or 'Deeplings'. ...
npc.navigator.multi_11: I am now convinced that when they first saw me descending in that suit with the light of the shimmer glower encompassing me, they took me for their God King Qjell. And that's when it all started to make sense. Don't you agree?
npc.navigator.multi_12: I was once captain of a ship, the Skyflare. We were traders for King Tibianus and on our way home when we got into a storm. We fought hard to escape the cold grip of the sea. ...
npc.navigator.multi_13: I myself did what I could to navigate the Skyflare out of this mess. They depended on me. Me, the navigator. And I succeeded. ...
npc.navigator.multi_14: However, when the sea calmed down and the rain was finally gone, we recognised that our ship wouldn't move. It wasn't my fault. ...
npc.navigator.multi_15: There was a strong gale and we could already see this island on the horizon. There were seagulls all around the Skyflare to lead us to dry land. But the ship did not move a single inch. It was NOT my fault. ...
npc.navigator.multi_16: We dived under the bow and saw that it was stuck right on the tip of a sharp rock. The world below us was treacherous, we could see large underwater mountains and a labyrinthine system of caves and holes. ...
npc.navigator.multi_17: Some of my men panicked and hijacked the dinghies to reach the island, others tried to swim. I remained on the ship. It was not my FAULT. It was not. ...
npc.navigator.multi_18: When none of my men returned, I forced myself to make a decision. Either dying on this dead ship or plunging into the liquid black beneath. ...
npc.navigator.multi_19: In my desperation my thoughts fell onto a strange armor - a gift from a trader we dealt with just before the storm. Strange ornaments and fish-like elements decorated this armor. We thought it would fit just perfectly into the captain's cabin. ...
npc.navigator.multi_2: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
npc.navigator.multi_20: He said something like a 'blessed breath' and 'to subdue the drift'. We thought he wanted to sell us worthless decoration and make it look interesting. If I had only listened to what he said. ...
npc.navigator.multi_21: I figured that this thing would have something to do with diving or at least protect me from the icy water. I put it on, grabbed a shimmer glower from our storage to light my path and jumped in. ...
npc.navigator.multi_22: Do you want me to go on?
npc.navigator.multi_23: NAAAAARGH. If you promise to leave me alone and NOT TO TELL MY SECRET to anyone - you can have one. ...
npc.navigator.multi_24: NO! Not the one I'm wearing. I am BOUND to this device. This suit has granted me a longer life. However, once you have spent a certain time with this - there is no turning back if you know what I mean. ...
npc.navigator.multi_25: The armor will merge with your very body. Holding you captive, holding your life in its hands like a ransom. ...
npc.navigator.multi_26: Using Deepling craft and various components from down here, I created several spare helmets - just in case this one gets damaged. If you return that small golden anchor to me, you can have one. Will you?
npc.navigator.multi_3: You thought you could choose sides? Think again! I nearly led you into the destruction of two species! ME, THE NAVIGATOR! I CONTROL YOU, I OWN YOU! QJELL AFAR GOU JEY!
npc.navigator.multi_4: Of course you do. And they did, too. They obeyed me. They adored me. They followed me. ...
npc.navigator.multi_5: I learnt everything about their culture, their life, their goals and their problems. I found out about vile insect-like creatures inhabiting the surface of the island. And their waiting for the return of Qjell. ...
npc.navigator.multi_6: I practically rewrote their history. I WAS THE SECOND COMING. I WAS QJELL. I, THE NAVIGATOR. ...
npc.navigator.multi_7: And I navigated them out of their miserable lives. Away from their petty interests. I led them to a greater purpose - to form chaos out of order, to bring back the storm to the seas and to make THINGS MOVE. Do you want to hear the rest as well?
npc.navigator.multi_8: Hmpf. The armor was working. After some time I was surrounded by darkness and could only see as far as my shimmer glower would me allow to. But I didn't feel the cold - I could even breathe through that helmet. ...
npc.navigator.multi_9: I dived into the deep black. Across rugged mountains, vast fields of kelp, swarms of strange fish. ...
npc.navigator.say_1: Lhnjei gouthn naumpi! I know why you are here. I can {explain} everything.
npc.navigator.say_2: By entering this place, you have earned the right to learn what this is all about. This is a long story. Are you sure you want to hear this, {yes}?
npc.navigator.say_3: Do you have enough, can I stop?
npc.navigator.say_4: Then take this one. And remember: DO NOT TELL ANYONE ABOUT ME OR ANYTHING YOU HAVE HEARD HERE TODAY.

npc.nielson.voice_1: Passages to Senja, Folda and Vega.
npc.nilsor.greet_msg_1: Greetings, traveller |PLAYERNAME|. Is there anything I can {do for you}?
npc.nilsor.multi_1: A thousand thanks in advance. I need no less than 7 ingredients for the cure. You can ask me about each specifically ...
npc.nilsor.multi_10: Are you willing to help me?
npc.nilsor.multi_2: I need a part of the sun adorer cactus, a vial of geyser water, sulphur of a lava hole, a frostbite herb, a blossom of a purple kiss, a hydra tongue and spores of a giant glimmercap mushroom ...
npc.nilsor.multi_3: Turn them in individually by talking about them to me. As soon as I obtained them all, talk to me about the medicine. First time bring a Part of the Sun Adorer {Cactus}.
npc.nilsor.multi_4: You will need a specially prepared waterskin to collect the water. You can buy one from me ...
npc.nilsor.multi_5: Use it on a geyser that is NOT active. The water of active geysers is far too hot. You can find inactive geysers on Okolnir. Do you have some geyser water with you?
npc.nilsor.multi_6: Thank you. Now I have all necessary ingredients. As a reward I grant you the use of our dog sled, which is located to the east of here. ...
npc.nilsor.multi_7: The dogs can be a bit moody, but if you always carry some ham with you there shouldnt be any problems. Oh, and Hjaern might have a mission for you. So maybe you go and talk to him.
npc.nilsor.multi_8: I am in dire need of help. A plague has befallen my dogs. I even called a druid of Carlin for help but all he could do was to recommend some strong medicine ...
npc.nilsor.multi_9: The thing is the ingredients of the medicine are extremely rare and some only exist in far away and distant lands. If you could help me collecting the ingredients, I would be eternally grateful ...

npc.nilsor.say_10: The giant glimmercap mushroom exists in caves and other preferably warm and humid places. Use an ordinary kitchen spoon on a mushroom to collectits spores. Do you have the glimmercap spores?

npc.nilsor.say_3: I have now no mission for you.
npc.nilsor.say_4: Do you want to buy a waterskin for 25 gold?
npc.nilsor.say_5: You will find this kind of cactus at places that are called deserts. Only an ordinary kitchen knife will be precise enough to produce the ingredient weneed. Do you have a part of that cactus with you?
npc.nilsor.say_6: I need fine sulphur of an inactive lava hole. No other sulphur will do. Use an ordinary kitchen spoon on an inactive lava hole. Do you have fine sulphur with you?
npc.nilsor.say_7: The frostbite herb is a local plant but its quite rare. You can find it on mountain peaks. You will need to cut it with a fine kitchen knife. Do you have a frostbite herb with you?
npc.nilsor.say_8: The purple kiss is a plant that grows in a place called jungle. You will have to use a kitchen knife to harvest its blossom. Do you have a blossom of a purple kiss with you?
npc.nilsor.say_9: The hydra tongue is a common pest plant in warmer regions. You might find one in a shop. Do you have a hydra tongue with you?
npc.nina.greet_msg_1: Beware, if you go any further you will have to fight a large group of Chosen. This place is called the Fire Dragon Dojo. Tread carefully since these are lizard training grounds.
npc.nina.stdmod_1: The lizards here are the chosen ones of their kind. We believe them to be the strongest warriors in these lands.So I lead my people here to learn their ways. We are mere assassins but they are using foreign techniques and seem to be far more efficient
npc.nina.stdmod_2: We of the Grey Shadow clan are studying the ways of the Chosen. Our training is hard, encounters with the lizards often deadly. Every one of us fights on his own. Each one more deadly than the other. Under my lead we wil rise renewed, as the Shadow Nina.
npc.nina.stdmod_3: I am Nina, leader of the Grey Shadow clan. Me and my followers, the Shadow Nina, are exploring the largely uncharted parts of the continent Zao.
npc.ninev.greet_msg_1: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free or you want the {adventurer stone}?
npc.ninev.keyword_1: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.ninev.stdmod_1: Alright, I guess you need a stake first. Maybe Gamon can help you, the leg of a chair or something could just do. Try asking him for a stake, and if you have one, bring it back to me.

npc.ninev.stdmod_32:
A blessed stake to defeat evil spirits? I do know an old prayer which is said to grant sacred power and to be able to bind this power to someone, or something. ... \z
	However, this prayer needs the combined energy of ten priests. Each of them has to say one line of the prayer. ... \z
	I could start with the prayer, but since the next priest has to be in a different location, you probably will have to travel a lot. ... \z
	Is this stake really important enough to you so that you are willing to take this burden?
npc.ninev.stdmod_33:
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
npc.ninev.stdmod_4: So receive my prayer: 'Light shall be near - and darkness afar'. Now, bring your stake to Tibra in the Carlin church for the next line of the prayer. I will inform her what to do.
npc.ninev.stdmod_6: You should visit Tibra in the Carlin church now.
npc.ninev.stdmod_7: You already received my line of the prayer.
npc.ninev.stdmod_8: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.ninev.stdmod_9: Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
